## 14.16 Docker + Nginx

Di production, semua service jalan di Docker containers. Ini setup lengkap: Nginx + Go App + PostgreSQL + Redis dalam docker-compose.

### Nginx Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# Dockerfile.nginx
# Custom Nginx image dengan config kita

FROM nginx:1.27-alpine

# Hapus default config
RUN rm /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

# Copy custom config
COPY nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
COPY nginx/conf.d/ /etc/nginx/conf.d/

# (Opsional) Copy static files
# COPY static/ /var/www/taskmanager/static/

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
    CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost/health || exit 1

EXPOSE 80 443
```

### Nginx Config untuk Docker

```nginx
# nginx/conf.d/taskmanager.conf
# Nginx config for Docker environment

# ============================================
# Upstream — Go App
# ============================================
upstream task_api {
    server api:8080;
    # "api" = service name di docker-compose
    # Docker DNS resolve "api" ke container IP
}

# ============================================
# HTTP → HTTPS Redirect (production)
# Uncomment ini kalau pakai SSL
# ============================================
# server {
#     listen 80;
#     server_name api.taskmanager.com;
#     return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
# }

# ============================================
# Main Server
# ============================================
server {
    listen 80;
    # Untuk production dengan SSL, ganti ke:
    # listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name api.taskmanager.com;

    # ---- Security ----
    server_tokens off;

    # ---- Security Headers ----
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
    add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
    add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
    add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'" always;
    add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" always;

    # ---- Gzip ----
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_min_length 256;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css text/xml text/javascript
               application/json application/javascript application/xml
               application/xml+rss image/svg+xml;

    # ---- Static Files ----
    location /static/ {
        alias /var/www/taskmanager/static/;
        expires 30d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
    }

    # ---- Health Check (for Docker/LB) ----
    location /health {
        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        access_log off;
    }

    # ---- API Reverse Proxy ----
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
        proxy_send_timeout 60s;
        proxy_read_timeout 60s;
    }

    # ---- WebSocket (kalau perlu) ----
    location /ws/ {
        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
    }

    # ---- Error Pages ----
    error_page 502 /502.html;
    location = /502.html {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        internal;
    }
}
```

### Nginx Main Config

```nginx
# nginx/nginx.conf
# Main Nginx configuration

worker_processes auto;
error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log warn;
pid /var/run/nginx.pid;

events {
    worker_connections 1024;
    multi_accept on;
}

http {
    include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type application/octet-stream;

    # ---- Logging ----
    log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] '
                    '"$request" $status $body_bytes_sent '
                    '"$http_referer" "$http_user_agent" '
                    'rt=$request_time uct=$upstream_connect_time '
                    'uht=$upstream_header_time urt=$upstream_response_time';

    access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log main;

    # ---- Performance ----
    sendfile on;
    tcp_nopush on;
    tcp_nodelay on;
    keepalive_timeout 65;
    types_hash_max_size 2048;
    client_max_body_size 10m;    # Max upload size 10MB

    # ---- Rate Limiting ----
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api_limit:10m rate=10r/s;
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=login_limit:5m rate=5r/m;
    limit_req_status 429;

    # ---- Include site configs ----
    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
}
```

### Full docker-compose.yml dengan Nginx

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
# Task Manager API — Full Stack with Nginx
# Usage: docker compose up -d

services:
  # ============================================
  # Nginx — Reverse Proxy / Load Balancer
  # ============================================
  nginx:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.nginx
    container_name: task-manager-nginx
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      # Nginx config (kalau mau edit tanpa rebuild)
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./nginx/conf.d:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
      # SSL certificates (kalau pakai Let's Encrypt)
      # - /etc/letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
      # Static files
      - ./static:/var/www/taskmanager/static:ro
      # Logs
      - nginx_logs:/var/log/nginx
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - task-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ============================================
  # Go API — Task Manager
  # ============================================
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: task-manager-api
    # Port TIDAK di-expose ke host!
    # Cuma accessible dari dalam Docker network (via Nginx)
    expose:
      - "8080"
    environment:
      - APP_ENV=production
      - PORT=8080
      - DB_HOST=postgres
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_USER=postgres
      - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-supersecret}
      - DB_NAME=task_manager
      - REDIS_HOST=redis
      - REDIS_PORT=6379
      - REDIS_PASSWORD=${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
      - JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET:-change-this-in-production}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - task-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s

  # ============================================
  # PostgreSQL — Database
  # ============================================
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: task-manager-db
    # Port TIDAK di-expose ke host (security)
    expose:
      - "5432"
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD:-supersecret}
      - POSTGRES_DB=task_manager
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - task-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # ============================================
  # Redis — Cache & Rate Limiting
  # ============================================
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: task-manager-redis
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    expose:
      - "6379"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - task-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

# ============================================
# Volumes
# ============================================
volumes:
  postgres_data:
    name: task-manager-postgres-data
  redis_data:
    name: task-manager-redis-data
  nginx_logs:
    name: task-manager-nginx-logs

# ============================================
# Networks
# ============================================
networks:
  task-network:
    name: task-manager-network
    driver: bridge
```

### Perhatikan Perbedaan: `ports` vs `expose`

```yaml
# PORTS — Expose ke host machine (accessible dari luar)
nginx:
  ports:
    - "80:80"     # User bisa akses http://server-ip:80
    - "443:443"   # User bisa akses https://server-ip:443

# EXPOSE — Cuma accessible dari dalam Docker network
api:
  expose:
    - "8080"      # Cuma Nginx yang bisa akses (internal Docker network)

postgres:
  expose:
    - "5432"      # Cuma Go app yang bisa akses (internal)

# Security best practice:
# HANYA Nginx yang expose ports ke public
# Backend services (Go, Postgres, Redis) cuma expose ke internal network
```

### Build dan Run

```bash
# Build semua services
docker compose build

# Start semua services
docker compose up -d

# Check status
docker compose ps
# NAME                    STATUS     PORTS
# task-manager-nginx      Up         0.0.0.0:80->80/tcp, 0.0.0.0:443->443/tcp
# task-manager-api        Up         8080/tcp (not published to host!)
# task-manager-db         Up         5432/tcp (not published to host!)
# task-manager-redis      Up         6379/tcp (not published to host!)

# Test
curl http://localhost/health
# {"status":"ok"}

# Check Nginx logs
docker compose logs nginx

# Check all logs
docker compose logs -f
```

## 14.17 Multiple Apps / Subdomains

Satu Nginx server bisa handle **banyak aplikasi** di domain/subdomain berbeda. Ini namanya **virtual hosting**.

### Setup Multiple Server Blocks

```nginx
# /etc/nginx/conf.d/api.taskmanager.conf
# Backend API (Go)
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name api.taskmanager.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

# /etc/nginx/conf.d/admin.taskmanager.conf
# Admin Dashboard (React/Vue frontend)
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name admin.taskmanager.com;

    # Serve frontend build (static files)
    root /var/www/taskmanager-admin/dist;
    index index.html;

    # SPA routing — semua route ke index.html
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # API proxy (kalau frontend perlu akses API)
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

# /etc/nginx/conf.d/docs.taskmanager.conf
# API Documentation (Swagger/Redoc)
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name docs.taskmanager.com;

    root /var/www/taskmanager-docs;
    index index.html;

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
}
```

### Docker Compose dengan Multiple Apps

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml — Multi-app setup

services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    container_name: nginx-proxy
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./nginx/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./nginx/conf.d:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
    depends_on:
      - api
      - admin
    networks:
      - app-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  api:
    build: ./backend
    container_name: task-api
    expose:
      - "8080"
    networks:
      - app-network

  admin:
    build: ./frontend
    container_name: task-admin
    expose:
      - "3000"
    networks:
      - app-network
```

```nginx
# nginx/conf.d/apps.conf — Multiple apps in Docker

# Backend API
upstream api_backend {
    server api:8080;
}

# Admin Frontend
upstream admin_frontend {
    server admin:3000;
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name api.taskmanager.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://api_backend;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name admin.taskmanager.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://admin_frontend;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }
}
```

### DNS Setup

```
Untuk multiple subdomains, kamu perlu DNS records:

A Record:
api.taskmanager.com    → 13.250.xx.xx (IP server)
admin.taskmanager.com  → 13.250.xx.xx (IP server yang sama!)
docs.taskmanager.com   → 13.250.xx.xx (IP server yang sama!)

Semua subdomain point ke IP yang SAMA.
Nginx yang memutuskan request mana ke app mana
berdasarkan "Host" header dari request.
```

## 14.18 Performance Tuning

### Worker Processes dan Connections

```nginx
# ============================================
# Performance Tuning — nginx.conf
# ============================================

# Worker processes = jumlah CPU cores
# "auto" = detect otomatis
worker_processes auto;

# CPU affinity — bind worker ke specific CPU core
# Ini opsional, tapi bisa improve performance di high-traffic
# worker_cpu_affinity auto;

# Max open files per worker (increase untuk high traffic)
worker_rlimit_nofile 65535;

events {
    # Max connections per worker
    # Rule of thumb: worker_connections = worker_rlimit_nofile / worker_processes
    worker_connections 4096;

    # Accept multiple connections at once
    multi_accept on;

    # Use epoll (Linux) — most efficient event method
    use epoll;
    # Di macOS otomatis pakai kqueue
}

http {
    # ---- Keepalive ----
    keepalive_timeout 65;     # Keep connection alive 65s
    keepalive_requests 1000;  # Max requests per keepalive connection

    # ---- Buffers ----
    client_body_buffer_size 16k;     # Buffer untuk request body
    client_header_buffer_size 1k;    # Buffer untuk request header
    large_client_header_buffers 4 8k; # Large header buffer
    client_max_body_size 10m;        # Max upload size (10MB)

    # ---- Timeouts ----
    client_body_timeout 12;      # Timeout baca client request body
    client_header_timeout 12;    # Timeout baca client request header
    send_timeout 10;             # Timeout kirim response ke client

    # ---- File handling ----
    sendfile on;           # Efficient file transfer (bypass user space)
    tcp_nopush on;         # Send headers in one packet
    tcp_nodelay on;        # Disable Nagle's algorithm (reduce latency)

    # ---- Open file cache ----
    open_file_cache max=1000 inactive=20s;
    open_file_cache_valid 30s;
    open_file_cache_min_uses 2;
    open_file_cache_errors on;
}
```

### Benchmark dengan ab (Apache Benchmark)

```bash
# Install ab (biasanya udah ada di server)
sudo apt install apache2-utils -y   # Ubuntu
brew install httpd                   # macOS

# Basic benchmark — 1000 requests, 10 concurrent
ab -n 1000 -c 10 http://api.taskmanager.com/health

# Output yang penting:
# Requests per second: 2500.00 [#/sec]     ← RPS
# Time per request: 4.000 [ms]             ← Avg response time
# Transfer rate: 500.00 [Kbytes/sec]
#
# Percentage of the requests served within a certain time (ms)
#   50%      3
#   90%      5
#   99%      12
```

### Benchmark dengan wrk (lebih advanced)

```bash
# Install wrk
sudo apt install wrk -y    # Ubuntu
brew install wrk            # macOS

# Basic benchmark — 10 threads, 100 connections, 30 seconds
wrk -t10 -c100 -d30s http://api.taskmanager.com/health

# Output:
# Running 30s test @ http://api.taskmanager.com/health
#   10 threads and 100 connections
#   Thread Stats   Avg      Stdev     Max   +/- Stdev
#     Latency     2.50ms    1.20ms   30ms    90%
#     Req/Sec     4.2k      500      6.0k    70%
#   1,260,000 requests in 30s, 200MB read
# Requests/sec:  42,000.00        ← Ini bagus!
# Transfer/sec:  6.67MB

# Benchmark dengan specific endpoint + headers
wrk -t10 -c100 -d30s \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs..." \
  http://api.taskmanager.com/api/v1/tasks
```

### Performance Target

```
Target untuk API:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Health check endpoint: > 10,000 RPS
API endpoint (with DB): > 1,000 RPS
P99 latency: < 100ms

Kalau belum achieve:
1. Check Nginx config (worker_processes, connections)
2. Check Go app (goroutine leaks, slow queries)
3. Check database (indexes, connection pool)
4. Check Redis (cache hit rate)
5. Scale horizontally (more instances + load balancing)
```

## 14.19 Common Issues & Debugging

### 502 Bad Gateway

```
Artinya: Nginx bisa terima request, tapi BACKEND GA BISA DIREACH.

Penyebab umum:
1. Go app ga running
2. Go app listen di port yang salah
3. proxy_pass URL salah
4. Firewall block connection internal
5. Docker: service name salah di proxy_pass

Debugging:
```

```bash
# 1. Check Go app running ga?
curl http://localhost:8080/health
# Kalau error → Go app ga running

# 2. Check process
ps aux | grep task-manager
# Atau di Docker:
docker compose ps

# 3. Check Go app logs
docker compose logs api

# 4. Check Nginx error log
sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log
# Biasanya ada: "connect() failed (111: Connection refused)"
# Artinya: backend ga available

# 5. Verify proxy_pass URL
nginx -T | grep proxy_pass
```

### 504 Gateway Timeout

```
Artinya: Backend TERLALU LAMA respond. Nginx nyerah nunggu.

Penyebab umum:
1. Query database lambat (missing index, heavy query)
2. External API call timeout
3. Deadlock atau infinite loop di Go app
4. proxy_read_timeout terlalu kecil

Fix:
```

```nginx
# Increase timeout (tapi jangan terlalu besar!)
location / {
    proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
    proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
    proxy_send_timeout 60s;
    proxy_read_timeout 120s;    # Increase dari 60s ke 120s
}
```

```bash
# Cari endpoint yang lambat di Nginx log
grep 'rt=[1-9]' /var/log/nginx/taskmanager_access.log | tail -20

# Check Go app performance
# Tambah logging di middleware untuk response time
```

### Permission Denied

```
Artinya: Nginx ga punya permission buat akses file/directory.

Penyebab umum:
1. Static files owned by root, tapi Nginx jalan sebagai www-data
2. Log directory ga writable
3. SELinux blocking (di CentOS/RHEL)

Fix:
```

```bash
# Check Nginx user
grep "user" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
# user www-data;

# Fix file permissions
sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/taskmanager/
sudo chmod -R 755 /var/www/taskmanager/

# Fix log permissions
sudo chown -R www-data:adm /var/log/nginx/
```

### Config Test dan Reload vs Restart

```bash
# SELALU test config sebelum reload/restart!
sudo nginx -t
# nginx: the configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf syntax is ok
# nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful

# RELOAD (recommended — zero downtime)
sudo systemctl reload nginx
# - Worker processes baru di-start dengan config baru
# - Worker processes lama selesaikan request yang ongoing
# - Setelah selesai, worker lama di-kill
# - ZERO DOWNTIME!

# RESTART (kalau reload ga cukup)
sudo systemctl restart nginx
# - Nginx di-stop
# - Nginx di-start dengan config baru
# - ADA DOWNTIME (sebentar, tapi ada)
# - Pakai ini kalau binary Nginx di-update
```

### Common Config Mistakes

```nginx
# MISTAKE 1: Lupa semicolon
server_name api.taskmanager.com    # ← Missing semicolon!

# MISTAKE 2: Lupa closing bracket
server {
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
    }
# ← Missing closing bracket for server!

# MISTAKE 3: proxy_pass trailing slash
location /api/ {
    proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;     # Request: /api/tasks → Backend: /api/tasks
    proxy_pass http://localhost:8080/;    # Request: /api/tasks → Backend: /tasks
    #                                ^^^ Trailing slash = strip location prefix!
}

# MISTAKE 4: Duplicate listen + server_name
# Dua server block dengan listen 80 dan server_name yang sama
# → Nginx ambil yang pertama, ignore yang kedua

# MISTAKE 5: Config file ga di-include
# File ada di conf.d/ tapi extension-nya bukan .conf
# nginx.conf: include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
# ← File .txt atau tanpa extension ga ke-include!
```

### Debug Checklist

```bash
# 1. Config valid?
sudo nginx -t

# 2. Nginx running?
sudo systemctl status nginx

# 3. Port 80/443 accessible?
sudo ss -tlnp | grep -E ':80|:443'

# 4. Backend accessible dari Nginx server?
curl http://localhost:8080/health

# 5. DNS resolve ke IP yang benar?
nslookup api.taskmanager.com
dig api.taskmanager.com

# 6. Firewall blocking?
sudo ufw status        # Ubuntu
sudo iptables -L       # Generic

# 7. Error log bilang apa?
sudo tail -50 /var/log/nginx/error.log

# 8. Access log ada request masuk?
sudo tail -50 /var/log/nginx/access.log

# 9. Docker: container semua running?
docker compose ps

# 10. Docker: bisa ping service lain?
docker compose exec nginx ping api
```

## 14.20 Nginx vs Alternatives

Nginx bukan satu-satunya pilihan. Ada beberapa alternatif yang worth considering:

### Caddy — Auto HTTPS, Zero Config

```
Caddy:
━━━━━━
- Written in Go (kita kan belajar Go!)
- AUTO HTTPS — Let's Encrypt otomatis, zero config
- Config JAUH lebih simple dari Nginx
- Perfect untuk project kecil-menengah
- Reverse proxy, static files, load balancing — semua ada

Kelebihan:
+ Auto HTTPS (ga perlu Certbot, ga perlu manual renewal)
+ Config file super simple (Caddyfile)
+ HTTP/2 dan HTTP/3 out of the box
+ Built-in access log, error log
+ Cocok banget untuk developer yang ga mau ribet

Kekurangan:
- Lebih lambat dari Nginx untuk static files
- Community lebih kecil
- Kurang customizable dibanding Nginx
- Jarang dipakai di enterprise/large scale
```

```
# Caddyfile — seluruh reverse proxy + HTTPS dalam 4 baris!
api.taskmanager.com {
    reverse_proxy localhost:8080
}

# Bandingkan dengan Nginx yang butuh 30+ baris config.
# Caddy auto-generate SSL certificate dari Let's Encrypt!
```

### Traefik — Docker-Native

```
Traefik:
━━━━━━━
- Designed untuk Docker dan Kubernetes
- Auto-discover containers (ga perlu manual config)
- Dashboard built-in
- Let's Encrypt built-in

Kelebihan:
+ Auto-discover Docker containers (pakai labels)
+ Perfect untuk microservices
+ Dashboard untuk monitoring
+ Native support Docker, Kubernetes, Consul

Kekurangan:
- Config lebih complex (YAML/TOML)
- Performance dibawah Nginx untuk static files
- Overkill untuk single-app deployment
- Learning curve lebih curam
```

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml dengan Traefik
services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

  api:
    build: .
    labels:
      - "traefik.http.routers.api.rule=Host(`api.taskmanager.com`)"
      - "traefik.http.services.api.loadbalancer.server.port=8080"
    # Traefik auto-detect container dan route traffic!
```

### HAProxy — Pure Load Balancer

```
HAProxy:
━━━━━━━
- Fokus ke load balancing dan proxying
- Paling mature, paling battle-tested
- Dipake oleh GitHub, Stack Overflow, Reddit

Kelebihan:
+ Performance terbaik untuk pure proxying
+ Advanced load balancing algorithms
+ Health checking yang sangat baik
+ Rate limiting yang lebih granular

Kekurangan:
- Ga bisa serve static files
- Ga ada SSL termination built-in (butuh tambahan)
- Config syntax kurang intuitif
- Overkill untuk project kecil
```

### Kapan Pakai Apa?

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Decision Matrix                           │
│                                                             │
│  Project kecil, 1 developer, mau simple?                   │
│  → CADDY (auto HTTPS, config 4 baris)                      │
│                                                             │
│  Docker-heavy, microservices, dynamic containers?           │
│  → TRAEFIK (auto-discover, Docker-native)                  │
│                                                             │
│  Need extreme performance, enterprise, huge traffic?        │
│  → NGINX (battle-tested, most configurable)                 │
│                                                             │
│  Pure load balancing, ga perlu static files?                │
│  → HAPROXY (best-in-class LB)                              │
│                                                             │
│  Learning DevOps, interview prep, industri standard?        │
│  → NGINX (paling banyak diminta di job postings)            │
│                                                             │
│  Kita di bab ini: NGINX ← karena industri standard         │
│  Nanti di Kubernetes: bisa pakai Traefik atau Nginx Ingress│
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| Tool | Best For | Auto HTTPS | Static Files | Docker Native | Market Share |
|------|----------|------------|-------------|---------------|-------------|
| **Nginx** | General purpose, enterprise | Manual (Certbot) | Excellent | Good | 35% |
| **Caddy** | Small-medium projects | Built-in | Good | Good | ~5% |
| **Traefik** | Microservices, Docker/K8s | Built-in | No | Excellent | ~8% |
| **HAProxy** | Pure load balancing | No | No | Good | ~10% |

## 14.21 Full Production Config

Ini dia **complete production config** untuk Task Manager API. Copy-paste ready. Semua yang udah kita bahas digabung jadi satu.

### nginx.conf (Main Config)

```nginx
# /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
# Task Manager API — Production Configuration
# ==============================================

user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
worker_rlimit_nofile 65535;
pid /run/nginx.pid;
error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log warn;

events {
    worker_connections 4096;
    multi_accept on;
    use epoll;
}

http {
    # ============================================
    # Basic Settings
    # ============================================
    include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type application/octet-stream;
    charset utf-8;
    server_tokens off;            # Hide Nginx version

    # ============================================
    # Logging
    # ============================================
    log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] '
                    '"$request" $status $body_bytes_sent '
                    '"$http_referer" "$http_user_agent" '
                    'rt=$request_time uct=$upstream_connect_time '
                    'uht=$upstream_header_time urt=$upstream_response_time';

    log_format json escape=json
        '{'
            '"time": "$time_iso8601", '
            '"remote_addr": "$remote_addr", '
            '"request": "$request", '
            '"status": $status, '
            '"body_bytes_sent": $body_bytes_sent, '
            '"request_time": $request_time, '
            '"upstream_response_time": "$upstream_response_time", '
            '"user_agent": "$http_user_agent"'
        '}';

    access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log main;

    # ============================================
    # Performance
    # ============================================
    sendfile on;
    tcp_nopush on;
    tcp_nodelay on;
    keepalive_timeout 65;
    keepalive_requests 1000;
    types_hash_max_size 2048;

    # Buffers
    client_body_buffer_size 16k;
    client_header_buffer_size 1k;
    large_client_header_buffers 4 8k;
    client_max_body_size 10m;

    # Timeouts
    client_body_timeout 12;
    client_header_timeout 12;
    send_timeout 10;

    # Open file cache
    open_file_cache max=1000 inactive=20s;
    open_file_cache_valid 30s;
    open_file_cache_min_uses 2;

    # ============================================
    # Gzip Compression
    # ============================================
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_min_length 256;
    gzip_types
        text/plain
        text/css
        text/xml
        text/javascript
        application/json
        application/javascript
        application/xml
        application/xml+rss
        application/vnd.ms-fontobject
        font/ttf
        font/opentype
        image/svg+xml;

    # ============================================
    # Rate Limiting
    # ============================================
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api_limit:10m rate=10r/s;
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=login_limit:5m rate=5r/m;
    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=register_limit:5m rate=2r/m;
    limit_req_status 429;
    limit_req_log_level warn;

    # ============================================
    # Upstream (Backend Servers)
    # ============================================
    upstream task_api {
        least_conn;
        server 127.0.0.1:8080 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        # Tambah server di bawah untuk load balancing:
        # server 127.0.0.1:8081 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
        # server 127.0.0.1:8082 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
    }

    # ============================================
    # Include site configs
    # ============================================
    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
    include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}
```

### taskmanager.conf (Site Config)

```nginx
# /etc/nginx/sites-available/taskmanager.conf
# Task Manager API — Site Configuration (Production)
# ====================================================

# ============================================
# HTTP → HTTPS Redirect
# ============================================
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name api.taskmanager.com;

    # Let's Encrypt challenge (keep this for certificate renewal)
    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
        root /var/www/certbot;
    }

    # Redirect everything else to HTTPS
    location / {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
}

# ============================================
# HTTPS Server — Main Config
# ============================================
server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    listen [::]:443 ssl http2;
    server_name api.taskmanager.com;

    # ---- SSL CERTIFICATE ----
    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/api.taskmanager.com/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/api.taskmanager.com/privkey.pem;

    # ---- SSL SETTINGS ----
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    ssl_session_timeout 1d;
    ssl_session_tickets off;
    ssl_stapling on;
    ssl_stapling_verify on;
    resolver 8.8.8.8 8.8.4.4 valid=300s;
    resolver_timeout 5s;

    # ---- SECURITY HEADERS ----
    add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload" always;
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
    add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
    add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
    add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'" always;
    add_header Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" always;

    # ---- ACCESS LOG ----
    access_log /var/log/nginx/taskmanager_access.log main;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/taskmanager_error.log warn;

    # ============================================
    # Health Check (no logging, no rate limit)
    # ============================================
    location = /health {
        access_log off;
        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }

    # ============================================
    # Static Files
    # ============================================
    location /uploads/ {
        alias /var/www/taskmanager/uploads/;
        expires 7d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
    }

    location /static/ {
        alias /var/www/taskmanager/static/;
        expires 30d;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
        access_log off;
    }

    location = /favicon.ico {
        alias /var/www/taskmanager/static/favicon.ico;
        access_log off;
        log_not_found off;
    }

    # ============================================
    # Login Endpoint (strict rate limit)
    # ============================================
    location = /api/v1/auth/login {
        limit_req zone=login_limit burst=5 nodelay;

        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # ============================================
    # Register Endpoint (strict rate limit)
    # ============================================
    location = /api/v1/auth/register {
        limit_req zone=register_limit burst=2 nodelay;

        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
    }

    # ============================================
    # WebSocket
    # ============================================
    location /ws/ {
        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
    }

    # ============================================
    # API — Catch All (general rate limit)
    # ============================================
    location / {
        limit_req zone=api_limit burst=20 nodelay;

        proxy_pass http://task_api;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
        proxy_send_timeout 60s;
        proxy_read_timeout 60s;

        proxy_buffering on;
        proxy_buffer_size 4k;
        proxy_buffers 8 4k;
    }

    # ============================================
    # Block common attack paths
    # ============================================
    location ~ /\. {
        deny all;          # Block .env, .git, .htaccess, dll
        access_log off;
        log_not_found off;
    }

    location ~* ^/(wp-admin|wp-login|xmlrpc|phpmyadmin) {
        deny all;          # Block WordPress/PHP attack vectors
        access_log off;
        log_not_found off;
    }
}
```

### Deploy Checklist untuk Config Ini

```bash
# 1. Copy config files
sudo cp nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
sudo cp taskmanager.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/taskmanager.conf

# 2. Enable site
sudo ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/taskmanager.conf /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/

# 3. Bikin directories
sudo mkdir -p /var/www/taskmanager/{static,uploads}
sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/taskmanager/
sudo mkdir -p /var/www/certbot

# 4. Test config
sudo nginx -t

# 5. Obtain SSL certificate
sudo certbot --nginx -d api.taskmanager.com

# 6. Reload Nginx
sudo systemctl reload nginx

# 7. Verify
curl -I https://api.taskmanager.com/health
# HTTP/2 200
# x-content-type-options: nosniff
# x-frame-options: DENY
# strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000...

# 8. Test SSL grade
# https://www.ssllabs.com/ssltest/analyze.html?d=api.taskmanager.com
```

## 14.22 Cheat Sheet

### Nginx Commands

```bash
# ========== INSTALL ==========
brew install nginx                       # macOS
sudo apt install nginx -y                # Ubuntu/Debian
docker run -d -p 80:80 nginx:alpine      # Docker

# ========== SERVICE ==========
sudo systemctl start nginx               # Start
sudo systemctl stop nginx                # Stop
sudo systemctl restart nginx             # Restart (ada downtime)
sudo systemctl reload nginx              # Reload config (zero downtime)
sudo systemctl status nginx              # Check status
sudo systemctl enable nginx              # Auto-start saat boot

# ========== CONFIG ==========
sudo nginx -t                            # Test config syntax
sudo nginx -T                            # Test + print full config
sudo nginx -V                            # Show version + compile options

# ========== SIGNALS ==========
sudo nginx -s stop                       # Fast shutdown
sudo nginx -s quit                       # Graceful shutdown
sudo nginx -s reload                     # Reload config
sudo nginx -s reopen                     # Reopen log files

# ========== LOGS ==========
sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/access.log   # Follow access log
sudo tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log    # Follow error log
sudo tail -100 /var/log/nginx/error.log  # Last 100 lines

# ========== SSL (CERTBOT) ==========
sudo certbot --nginx -d domain.com       # Obtain + auto-config
sudo certbot renew --dry-run             # Test renewal
sudo certbot renew                       # Manual renewal
sudo certbot certificates                # List certificates

# ========== DEBUG ==========
curl -I http://localhost                 # Check response headers
sudo ss -tlnp | grep nginx              # Check listening ports
ps aux | grep nginx                      # Check processes
```

### Common Config Patterns

```nginx
# ========== REVERSE PROXY ==========
location / {
    proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
}

# ========== LOAD BALANCING ==========
upstream backend {
    least_conn;
    server 127.0.0.1:8080;
    server 127.0.0.1:8081;
}
location / {
    proxy_pass http://backend;
}

# ========== HTTPS REDIRECT ==========
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name domain.com;
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

# ========== STATIC FILES ==========
location /static/ {
    alias /var/www/app/static/;
    expires 30d;
}

# ========== GZIP ==========
gzip on;
gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript;
gzip_min_length 256;
gzip_comp_level 6;

# ========== RATE LIMITING ==========
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api:10m rate=10r/s;
location /api/ {
    limit_req zone=api burst=20 nodelay;
}

# ========== SECURITY HEADERS ==========
add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
server_tokens off;

# ========== WEBSOCKET ==========
location /ws/ {
    proxy_pass http://localhost:8080;
    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
    proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
    proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
}

# ========== BLOCK HIDDEN FILES ==========
location ~ /\. {
    deny all;
}

# ========== CUSTOM ERROR PAGE ==========
error_page 502 /502.html;
location = /502.html {
    root /usr/share/nginx/html;
    internal;
}
```

### Config File Locations

```
macOS (Homebrew — Apple Silicon):
  Config:  /opt/homebrew/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
  Logs:    /opt/homebrew/var/log/nginx/
  Root:    /opt/homebrew/var/www/

macOS (Homebrew — Intel):
  Config:  /usr/local/etc/nginx/nginx.conf
  Logs:    /usr/local/var/log/nginx/
  Root:    /usr/local/var/www/

Ubuntu/Debian:
  Config:  /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
  Sites:   /etc/nginx/sites-available/
  Enabled: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
  Conf.d:  /etc/nginx/conf.d/
  Logs:    /var/log/nginx/
  Root:    /var/www/html/
  PID:     /run/nginx.pid

Docker (nginx:alpine):
  Config:  /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
  Conf.d:  /etc/nginx/conf.d/
  Logs:    /var/log/nginx/
  Root:    /usr/share/nginx/html/
```

## 14.23 Checklist Bab Ini

### Konsep Dasar

- [ ] Paham apa itu Nginx (web server, reverse proxy, load balancer)
- [ ] Paham perbedaan forward proxy vs reverse proxy
- [ ] Paham kenapa Nginx (C10K problem, event-driven, non-blocking)
- [ ] Paham perbedaan Apache vs Nginx
- [ ] Paham analogi resepsionis hotel

### Architecture

- [ ] Paham master process vs worker process
- [ ] Paham event-driven vs thread-based
- [ ] Paham config file structure (nginx.conf, sites-available, conf.d)
- [ ] Paham config hierarchy (main → events → http → server → location)

### Installation

- [ ] Nginx terinstall (brew / apt / Docker)
- [ ] Bisa jalanin nginx -t untuk test config
- [ ] Paham reload vs restart
- [ ] Tau lokasi config files di OS kamu

### Config Basics

- [ ] Paham directives dan blocks
- [ ] Paham syntax rules (semicolon, curly braces, comments)
- [ ] Paham location block matching dan priority

### Reverse Proxy

- [ ] Udah setup reverse proxy ke Go app (proxy_pass)
- [ ] Paham kenapa proxy headers penting (X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For, dll)
- [ ] Go app udah di-update untuk SetTrustedProxies
- [ ] Test reverse proxy berhasil (curl lewat Nginx)

### SSL/HTTPS

- [ ] Paham kenapa HTTPS wajib
- [ ] Certbot terinstall
- [ ] Udah obtain SSL certificate dari Let's Encrypt
- [ ] HTTP → HTTPS redirect berjalan
- [ ] SSL best practices (TLS 1.2+, HSTS, OCSP stapling)
- [ ] Auto-renewal cron/timer terpasang
- [ ] SSL grade A atau A+ di ssllabs.com

### Load Balancing

- [ ] Paham upstream block
- [ ] Paham algorithms: round-robin, least_conn, ip_hash, weighted
- [ ] Paham health check (max_fails, fail_timeout, backup)
- [ ] Tau kapan pakai algorithm yang mana

### Caching

- [ ] Paham proxy_cache setup
- [ ] Paham kapan cache vs tidak cache API response
- [ ] Paham cache bypass
- [ ] Tau bedanya caching di Nginx vs Redis

### Compression

- [ ] Gzip enabled di config
- [ ] Paham gzip_types dan gzip_comp_level
- [ ] Verify compression working (Content-Encoding: gzip)

### Rate Limiting

- [ ] Paham limit_req_zone dan limit_req
- [ ] Paham burst dan nodelay
- [ ] Setup rate limit berbeda per endpoint (login lebih ketat)
- [ ] Paham bedanya Nginx rate limit vs Redis rate limit

### Security

- [ ] Security headers lengkap (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, dll)
- [ ] server_tokens off (hide version)
- [ ] Block hidden files (location ~ /\\.)
- [ ] Block common attack paths (wp-admin, phpmyadmin)
- [ ] Verify di securityheaders.com

### Logging

- [ ] Access log dan error log configured
- [ ] Custom log format dengan response time
- [ ] Health check access log disabled
- [ ] Paham log rotation (logrotate)
- [ ] Bisa analisis log (top IPs, status codes, slow requests)

### Static Files

- [ ] Paham serve static files langsung dari Nginx
- [ ] Paham root vs alias
- [ ] Cache headers untuk static files (expires, Cache-Control)

### WebSocket

- [ ] Paham WebSocket proxy config
- [ ] Paham kenapa perlu Upgrade dan Connection headers
- [ ] Paham kenapa perlu proxy_http_version 1.1

### Docker Integration

- [ ] Nginx jalan sebagai Docker container
- [ ] docker-compose.yml include Nginx + Go + PostgreSQL + Redis
- [ ] Paham ports vs expose (security)
- [ ] Backend services TIDAK exposed ke host (cuma Nginx)
- [ ] Full stack bisa start dengan `docker compose up -d`

### Multiple Apps

- [ ] Paham virtual hosting (multiple server blocks)
- [ ] Bisa setup subdomain routing (api.*, admin.*)
- [ ] Paham DNS setup untuk subdomains

### Performance

- [ ] Paham worker_processes, worker_connections, keepalive
- [ ] Paham buffer sizes dan timeouts
- [ ] Bisa benchmark dengan ab atau wrk
- [ ] Tau target performance (RPS, latency)

### Debugging

- [ ] Bisa debug 502 Bad Gateway
- [ ] Bisa debug 504 Gateway Timeout
- [ ] Paham debug checklist (10 steps)
- [ ] Paham common config mistakes

### Alternatives

- [ ] Paham Caddy (auto HTTPS, simple config)
- [ ] Paham Traefik (Docker-native, microservices)
- [ ] Paham HAProxy (pure load balancer)
- [ ] Tau kapan pakai Nginx vs alternatives

### Production Ready

- [ ] Full production config sudah dibuat
- [ ] Config include: reverse proxy + SSL + gzip + rate limit + security headers + logging
- [ ] Config sudah di-test (nginx -t)
- [ ] Config sudah di-deploy dan verified

---

> **Next:** [Bab 15: Monitoring — Prometheus + Grafana](15-monitoring.md) — setelah Nginx di depan, kita perlu **pantau** semua yang terjadi. Berapa request per detik? Berapa error rate? CPU usage berapa? Response time naik ga? Di bab berikutnya kita setup Prometheus untuk collect metrics dan Grafana untuk visualisasi. Ini yang bikin kamu bisa tidur tenang kalau production running — karena kamu tau persis apa yang terjadi di system kamu.

# Bab 15: Monitoring — Prometheus + Grafana dari Nol Sampai Production

## Kenapa Bab Ini Penting?

Selamat. Kamu udah sampai di bab terakhir **Stage 2: DevOps Core**. Selama 4 bab terakhir — Docker, CI/CD, AWS, Nginx — kamu udah berhasil bikin pipeline yang bisa deploy Task Manager API ke production secara otomatis. API kamu jalan di cloud, ada HTTPS, ada reverse proxy, ada rate limiting. Keren.

Tapi ada satu masalah besar: **kamu ga tau apa yang terjadi di production.**

API kamu bisa aja error rate-nya naik 50% selama 3 jam, dan kamu ga tau sampai user komplain di Twitter. Database connection pool bisa aja penuh, response time naik dari 50ms jadi 5 detik, tapi kamu ga tau sampai bos nanya "Kok API-nya lemot ya?". Server bisa aja kehabisan memory, crash tengah malam, dan kamu baru tau pas bangun pagi buka Slack.

**Tanpa monitoring, kamu buta di production.**

```
Sebelum bab ini:
- API udah jalan di production (Docker + AWS + Nginx)
- CI/CD udah auto deploy
- Tapi... ga ada cara tau apakah API healthy
- Ga ada cara tau berapa request per detik
- Ga ada cara tau response time P95
- Ga ada alert kalau server down
- Kalau ada masalah, tau dari user yang komplain

Setelah bab ini:
- Prometheus scrape metrics dari Go app setiap 15 detik
- Grafana dashboard live — request rate, error rate, latency, memory
- Alert otomatis ke Telegram/Discord kalau ada masalah
- Structured logging (JSON) untuk debugging
- Loki untuk log aggregation
- Health check endpoints yang proper
- Full monitoring stack di docker-compose
- Kalau ada masalah, kamu tau SEBELUM user tau
```

Kalau kamu pernah pakai Laravel Telescope atau NestJS dengan PM2 monitoring, itu monitoring **level basic**. Di bab ini kita naik level — monitoring yang dipake perusahaan production beneran: Prometheus + Grafana.

> **Analogi gampang:** Monitoring itu kayak **dashboard mobil**. Speedometer ngasih tau kecepatan (request rate). Fuel gauge ngasih tau bensin sisa berapa (memory usage). RPM gauge ngasih tau mesin kerja seberapa keras (CPU usage). Engine warning light nyala kalau ada masalah (alerts). Bayangin nyetir mobil **tanpa dashboard** — ga tau kecepatan, ga tau bensin sisa berapa, ga tau engine overheat. Serem kan? Itulah production tanpa monitoring.

---

## 15.1 Kenapa Monitoring Penting

### "You Can't Fix What You Can't See"

Ini prinsip fundamental monitoring. Kalau kamu ga bisa **lihat** apa yang terjadi di system kamu, kamu ga bisa **fix** masalahnya. Simple as that.

```
Tanpa Monitoring:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. User komplain: "API lemot"
2. Kamu: "Hmm, coba gue SSH ke server"
3. SSH ke server, cek manually
4. Coba curl endpoint, kayaknya normal
5. "Mungkin internet user-nya aja kali"
6. 2 jam kemudian, makin banyak yang komplain
7. Ternyata database connection pool penuh sejak tadi pagi
8. Fix: restart app
9. Total downtime: 5 jam
10. Reputasi: rusak

Dengan Monitoring:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Alert Telegram: "P95 latency > 500ms sejak 08:15"
2. Buka Grafana dashboard
3. Lihat: DB connection pool 100% utilized
4. Lihat: query time spike mulai 08:10
5. Cek logs: ada slow query yang baru di-deploy semalam
6. Fix: rollback atau optimize query
7. Total downtime: 15 menit
8. Reputasi: "Wah DevOps-nya responsive banget"
```

### Horror Stories Tanpa Monitoring

Ini bukan cerita fiktif — ini kejadian nyata di industri:

```
Horror Story #1: "Server Down 3 Jam, Nobody Knew"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Startup e-commerce. Server API mati jam 2 pagi (OOM kill).
Ga ada monitoring, ga ada alert.
Team baru tau jam 8 pagi pas masuk kantor.
6 jam downtime. Kehilangan transaksi weekend.
Estimated loss: Rp 50 juta+

Horror Story #2: "Memory Leak yang Slow"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Go service punya goroutine leak.
Memory naik 10MB per jam. Ga terasa.
Setelah 3 hari, server pakai 8GB RAM (dari 4GB allocated).
OOM killer bunuh process. 502 Bad Gateway.
Kalau ada monitoring — memory graph naik terus,
alert trigger di hari pertama.

Horror Story #3: "Disk Full, Database Crash"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PostgreSQL log file ga di-rotate.
Disk usage naik pelan-pelan: 60%... 80%... 95%... 100%.
Database ga bisa write. Semua INSERT/UPDATE gagal.
API return 500 Internal Server Error.
Fix: hapus old logs, setup logrotate.
Kalau ada monitoring — disk usage alert di 80%.
```

### Kenapa Developer Perlu Tau Monitoring?

"Tapi kan monitoring itu kerjaannya SRE/DevOps?"

Betul, di perusahaan besar ada team SRE khusus. Tapi:

1. **Di startup, kamu yang handle semuanya** — ga ada SRE dedicated
2. **Kamu yang nulis kode** — kamu yang paling tau metric apa yang penting
3. **On-call rotation** — banyak perusahaan yang developer ikut on-call
4. **Career growth** — developer yang paham monitoring = senior engineer

```
Junior Developer:
"API-nya error? Hmm, coba restart aja"

Senior Developer:
"Error rate naik 3% sejak deploy terakhir.
P95 latency naik dari 50ms ke 200ms.
Root cause: query N+1 di endpoint GET /tasks.
Fix: eager loading, deploy hotfix,
verify error rate balik ke baseline."
```

Bedanya? **Data.** Senior engineer pakai data, bukan feeling.

---

## 15.2 Observability Stack — Three Pillars

### Apa Itu Observability?

Observability = kemampuan untuk **memahami** apa yang terjadi di dalam system dari **output** yang dihasilkan.

Beda sama monitoring:
- **Monitoring** = tau *bahwa* ada masalah ("server down!")
- **Observability** = tau *kenapa* ada masalah ("server down karena memory leak di goroutine X yang dipanggil endpoint Y")

### Three Pillars of Observability

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                THREE PILLARS OF OBSERVABILITY              │
│                                                            │
│  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐    │
│  │   METRICS    │  │    LOGS      │  │   TRACES     │    │
│  │              │  │              │  │              │    │
│  │  Angka       │  │  Event       │  │  Journey     │    │
│  │  (numbers)   │  │  (text)      │  │  (path)      │    │
│  │              │  │              │  │              │    │
│  │  "Berapa?"   │  │  "Apa yang   │  │  "Lewat      │    │
│  │              │  │   terjadi?"  │  │   mana?"     │    │
│  │              │  │              │  │              │    │
│  │  CPU: 75%    │  │  "User login │  │  Request →   │    │
│  │  RPS: 1200   │  │   failed:    │  │  Auth →      │    │
│  │  Latency:    │  │   invalid    │  │  DB Query →  │    │
│  │  50ms        │  │   password"  │  │  Cache →     │    │
│  │              │  │              │  │  Response    │    │
│  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘    │
│                                                            │
│  Tools:            Tools:            Tools:               │
│  Prometheus        ELK Stack         Jaeger               │
│  Datadog           Loki              Zipkin               │
│  CloudWatch        Fluentd           Tempo                │
│  InfluxDB          Papertrail        OpenTelemetry        │
│                                                            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Pillar 1: Metrics — "Berapa?"

Metrics itu **angka** yang menggambarkan kondisi system pada waktu tertentu. Metrics itu **aggregated** — bukan per-event, tapi summary.

```
Contoh metrics:
- Total HTTP requests: 1,234,567
- Request per second: 450 RPS
- Error rate: 2.3%
- P95 latency: 45ms
- Active goroutines: 127
- Memory usage: 256MB
- CPU usage: 35%
- Database connections: 15/20
```

**Kenapa penting:** Metrics ngasih kamu **big picture**. Kamu bisa lihat trend, compare timeframe, set alert threshold.

### Pillar 2: Logs — "Apa yang Terjadi?"

Logs itu **event** yang terjadi di aplikasi. Setiap log entry = satu kejadian spesifik.

```
Contoh logs:
[2026-05-01 10:15:33] INFO  User login successful: user_id=42, email=john@example.com
[2026-05-01 10:15:34] ERROR Failed to create task: board_id=5, error="board not found"
[2026-05-01 10:15:35] WARN  Rate limit exceeded: ip=203.0.113.50, limit=100/min
[2026-05-01 10:15:36] INFO  Task created: task_id=789, board_id=3, user_id=42
```

**Kenapa penting:** Logs ngasih kamu **detail**. Kalau metrics bilang "error rate naik", logs bilang "error-nya apa, di mana, kapan, user siapa".

### Pillar 3: Traces — "Lewat Mana?"

Traces itu **perjalanan satu request** melintasi seluruh system. Penting banget di microservices.

```
Trace ID: abc-123-def
├── API Gateway (2ms)
├── Auth Service - validate token (5ms)
├── Task Service - create task (45ms)
│   ├── PostgreSQL - INSERT task (12ms)
│   ├── Redis - invalidate cache (3ms)
│   └── RabbitMQ - publish event (8ms)
└── Total: 75ms
```

**Kenapa penting:** Traces ngasih kamu **path**. Kamu bisa lihat bottleneck ada di mana — DB query lambat? External API timeout?

### Focus Bab Ini

Di bab ini, kita fokus ke **Metrics** (Prometheus + Grafana) dan **Logs** (structured logging + Loki). Traces (Jaeger/Tempo) kita bahas nanti di bab microservices — karena traces paling berguna kalau udah multiple services.

```
Bab ini:
├── Metrics  → Prometheus + Grafana     ← FOKUS UTAMA
├── Logs     → Structured Logging + Loki ← FOKUS KEDUA
└── Traces   → (Bab 18: Microservices)   ← NANTI
```

---

## 15.3 Prometheus Overview

### Apa Itu Prometheus?

Prometheus itu **open-source monitoring system** dan **time-series database** yang dibuat oleh SoundCloud tahun 2012. Sekarang jadi project **CNCF graduated** (sama levelnya dengan Kubernetes).

```
Prometheus Facts:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Dibuat: 2012 di SoundCloud
- Open source: 2015
- CNCF graduated: 2018 (setelah Kubernetes)
- Bahasa: Go (tentu saja!)
- License: Apache 2.0
- Dipakai: SoundCloud, DigitalOcean, Docker, Uber, GitLab, dll
```

### Pull-Based Model (Scrape)

Yang bikin Prometheus beda dari tools monitoring lain: Prometheus **pull** (scrape) metrics dari target, bukan target yang **push** metrics ke Prometheus.

```
Push-Based (Datadog, StatsD):
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
App actively sends metrics to monitoring server.
App harus tau alamat monitoring server.

App A ─── push ───→ Monitoring Server
App B ─── push ───→ Monitoring Server
App C ─── push ───→ Monitoring Server

Pull-Based (Prometheus):
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Prometheus yang actively fetch metrics dari apps.
Apps cuma perlu expose /metrics endpoint.

Prometheus ─── scrape ───→ App A /metrics
Prometheus ─── scrape ───→ App B /metrics
Prometheus ─── scrape ───→ App C /metrics
```

**Keuntungan pull-based:**
1. App ga perlu tau Prometheus ada di mana
2. Prometheus bisa detect kalau target down (scrape gagal)
3. Gampang debug — kamu bisa buka `/metrics` di browser
4. Satu Prometheus bisa scrape banyak target

### Architecture

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Prometheus Architecture                     │
│                                                               │
│  ┌──────────┐     scrape      ┌──────────────────┐           │
│  │  Go App   │ ←─────────── │    Prometheus     │           │
│  │ /metrics  │               │                   │           │
│  └──────────┘               │  ┌──────────────┐ │           │
│                              │  │  Time-Series │ │           │
│  ┌──────────┐     scrape    │  │   Database   │ │           │
│  │  Node     │ ←─────────── │  └──────────────┘ │           │
│  │ Exporter  │               │                   │           │
│  └──────────┘               │  ┌──────────────┐ │           │
│                              │  │   PromQL     │ │           │
│  ┌──────────┐     scrape    │  │   Engine     │ │           │
│  │ PostgreSQL│ ←─────────── │  └──────────────┘ │           │
│  │ Exporter  │               │                   │           │
│  └──────────┘               │  ┌──────────────┐ │           │
│                              │  │Alert Manager │ │           │
│                              │  └──────┬───────┘ │           │
│                              └─────────┼─────────┘           │
│                                        │                      │
│              ┌─────────────────────────┼──────────┐          │
│              │                         │          │          │
│              ▼                         ▼          ▼          │
│  ┌──────────────────┐    ┌──────────┐  ┌────────────┐       │
│  │     Grafana       │    │ Telegram │  │  Discord   │       │
│  │   (Visualization) │    │   Bot    │  │  Webhook   │       │
│  └──────────────────┘    └──────────┘  └────────────┘       │
│                                                               │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Prometheus vs SaaS Alternatives

| Aspek | Prometheus + Grafana | Datadog | New Relic |
|-------|---------------------|---------|-----------|
| **Type** | Self-hosted (gratis) | SaaS (bayar) | SaaS (bayar) |
| **Cost** | $0 (infra doang) | $15-23/host/bulan | $25+/host/bulan |
| **Setup** | Manual (Docker) | Install agent, done | Install agent, done |
| **Customization** | Sangat fleksibel | Terbatas UI mereka | Terbatas UI mereka |
| **Data ownership** | Data di server kamu | Data di cloud mereka | Data di cloud mereka |
| **Learning curve** | Medium (PromQL) | Low | Low |
| **Community** | Huge (CNCF) | Good | Good |
| **Best for** | Tim yang mau kontrol penuh | Tim yang mau cepat setup | Enterprise |

```
Kapan Pakai Prometheus + Grafana:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Budget terbatas (startup, project pribadi)
- Mau kontrol penuh atas data
- Mau belajar monitoring beneran
- Udah pakai Kubernetes (Prometheus = standard)
- Data sensitive (ga mau di cloud orang lain)

Kapan Pakai Datadog/New Relic:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Budget banyak
- Ga mau maintain infrastructure monitoring
- Tim kecil, butuh cepat setup
- Butuh APM (Application Performance Monitoring) out-of-the-box
```

> **Fun fact:** Prometheus, Grafana, Docker, Kubernetes — semua ditulis pakai **Go**. Pattern-nya jelas: tools DevOps modern = Go. Makanya kamu belajar Go + DevOps itu combo yang pas banget.

---

## 15.4 Metric Types

Prometheus punya **4 tipe metric**. Kamu harus paham kapan pakai yang mana.

### 1. Counter — Naik Terus, Ga Pernah Turun

Counter itu angka yang **cuma naik** (atau reset ke 0 kalau restart). Cocok untuk hal-hal yang kamu **hitung**.

```
Counter = Odometer mobil
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Odometer cuma naik. Ga bisa turun.
Dari 10,000 km → 10,001 km → 10,002 km → ...
Reset cuma kalau mobil baru (restart).

Contoh Counter:
- http_requests_total: total request yang masuk (1, 2, 3, ..., 1000000)
- http_errors_total: total error (1, 2, 3, ..., 500)
- tasks_created_total: total task yang dibuat
- emails_sent_total: total email yang dikirim
- db_queries_total: total query ke database

JANGAN pakai counter untuk:
- CPU usage (bisa naik/turun)
- Active connections (bisa naik/turun)
- Temperature (bisa naik/turun)
```

### 2. Gauge — Bisa Naik, Bisa Turun

Gauge itu angka yang **bisa naik dan turun**. Cocok untuk hal-hal yang menunjukkan **kondisi saat ini**.

```
Gauge = Speedometer mobil
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Speedometer bisa naik dan turun.
0 km/h → 60 km/h → 100 km/h → 80 km/h → 0 km/h

Contoh Gauge:
- active_connections: koneksi aktif saat ini (naik/turun)
- cpu_usage_percent: CPU usage saat ini (0-100%)
- memory_usage_bytes: memory yang dipakai saat ini
- goroutines_count: jumlah goroutine aktif
- queue_size: jumlah item di queue saat ini
- temperature_celsius: suhu server

JANGAN pakai gauge untuk:
- Total requests (harusnya counter — cuma naik)
- Total errors (harusnya counter)
```

### 3. Histogram — Distribusi Nilai

Histogram **mengukur distribusi** dari suatu nilai — biasanya **durasi** atau **ukuran**. Histogram bisa kasih kamu percentile (P50, P90, P95, P99).

```
Histogram = Catatan lap time di balapan
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Kamu catat setiap lap time:
Lap 1: 1:45, Lap 2: 1:50, Lap 3: 1:42, Lap 4: 2:01, ...

Dari data itu, kamu bisa hitung:
- Rata-rata lap time
- Lap time tercepat
- 95% lap selesai dalam waktu berapa (P95)

Contoh Histogram:
- http_request_duration_seconds: berapa lama request diproses
  → Bucket: 0.005s, 0.01s, 0.025s, 0.05s, 0.1s, 0.25s, 0.5s, 1s, 5s
  → P95: 95% request selesai dalam 45ms

- http_response_size_bytes: seberapa besar response
  → P50: 50% response ukurannya < 2KB

- db_query_duration_seconds: berapa lama query ke database
```

Histogram otomatis bikin **3 metrics**:
- `_bucket`: jumlah observasi per bucket (le="0.1", le="0.5", dll)
- `_sum`: total sum dari semua observasi
- `_count`: total jumlah observasi

### 4. Summary — Mirip Histogram, Tapi Hitung Quantile di Client

Summary mirip histogram, tapi **quantile dihitung di sisi aplikasi** (bukan di Prometheus).

```
Summary vs Histogram:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Histogram:
- Bucket di-define di awal (0.01s, 0.05s, 0.1s, ...)
- Quantile dihitung di Prometheus pakai PromQL
- Bisa di-aggregate across instances
- Lebih fleksibel — RECOMMENDED

Summary:
- Quantile dihitung di aplikasi (phi=0.5, phi=0.95, phi=0.99)
- Lebih akurat untuk specific quantile
- TIDAK bisa di-aggregate across instances
- Cocok kalau kamu tau pasti quantile apa yang kamu mau
```

### Kapan Pakai Apa?

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              Metric Type Cheat Sheet                  │
│                                                       │
│  "Berapa TOTAL nya?"          → COUNTER               │
│    total requests, total errors, total tasks          │
│                                                       │
│  "Berapa SEKARANG?"           → GAUGE                 │
│    active users, CPU%, memory, goroutines             │
│                                                       │
│  "Berapa LAMA / BESAR?"      → HISTOGRAM              │
│    request duration, response size, query time        │
│                                                       │
│  "Berapa PERCENTILE (exact)?" → SUMMARY               │
│    (jarang dipakai, biasanya histogram cukup)         │
│                                                       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 15.5 Instrumenting Go App

### Install prometheus/client_golang

Library official Prometheus untuk Go. Ini standard-nya — semua Go app yang pakai Prometheus pake library ini.

```bash
go get github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus
go get github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp
go get github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promauto
```

### Setup /metrics Endpoint — Basic

Pertama, kita expose `/metrics` endpoint di Go app. Ini endpoint yang bakal di-scrape sama Prometheus.

```go
// internal/handler/metrics.go
package handler

import (
    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
)

// MetricsHandler wraps promhttp handler for Gin
func MetricsHandler() gin.HandlerFunc {
    h := promhttp.Handler()
    return func(c *gin.Context) {
        h.ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
    }
}
```

Register di router:

```go
// internal/router/router.go
func Setup(r *gin.Engine, h *Handlers, authService *service.AuthService, redisClient *redis.Client) {
    // Health check (public)
    r.GET("/health", handler.HealthCheck)

    // Prometheus metrics endpoint (public, tapi biasanya di-protect di Nginx)
    r.GET("/metrics", handler.MetricsHandler())

    // ... rest of routes
}
```

### Apa yang Udah Ke-expose?

Tanpa nulis custom metric apapun, Prometheus client_golang **otomatis** expose default Go metrics:

```bash
# Buka browser: http://localhost:8080/metrics

# HELP go_goroutines Number of goroutines that currently exist.
# TYPE go_goroutines gauge
go_goroutines 12

# HELP go_memstats_alloc_bytes Number of bytes allocated and still in use.
# TYPE go_memstats_alloc_bytes gauge
go_memstats_alloc_bytes 3.456e+06

# HELP go_gc_duration_seconds A summary of the pause duration of garbage collection cycles.
# TYPE go_gc_duration_seconds summary
go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="0"} 2.34e-05
go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="0.25"} 3.45e-05
go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="0.5"} 4.56e-05
go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="0.75"} 5.67e-05
go_gc_duration_seconds{quantile="1"} 0.000123

# HELP go_threads Number of OS threads created.
# TYPE go_threads gauge
go_threads 8

# HELP process_cpu_seconds_total Total user and system CPU time spent in seconds.
# TYPE process_cpu_seconds_total counter
process_cpu_seconds_total 0.45

# HELP process_resident_memory_bytes Resident memory size in bytes.
# TYPE process_resident_memory_bytes gauge
process_resident_memory_bytes 2.5e+07
```

Ini udah lumayan — kamu bisa monitor goroutines, memory, GC, CPU. Tapi kita perlu **custom metrics** yang spesifik untuk Task Manager API.

## 15.6 Custom Metrics untuk Task Manager

### Define Custom Metrics

Bikin file khusus untuk define semua custom metrics:

```go
// internal/metrics/metrics.go
package metrics

import (
    "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
    "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promauto"
)

var (
    // HTTP Metrics
    // Counter: total HTTP requests, labeled by method, path, status code
    HttpRequestsTotal = promauto.NewCounterVec(
        prometheus.CounterOpts{
            Name: "http_requests_total",
            Help: "Total number of HTTP requests",
        },
        []string{"method", "path", "status"},
    )

    // Histogram: HTTP request duration in seconds, labeled by method, path
    HttpRequestDuration = promauto.NewHistogramVec(
        prometheus.HistogramOpts{
            Name:    "http_request_duration_seconds",
            Help:    "HTTP request duration in seconds",
            Buckets: []float64{0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10},
        },
        []string{"method", "path"},
    )

    // Histogram: HTTP response size in bytes
    HttpResponseSize = promauto.NewHistogramVec(
        prometheus.HistogramOpts{
            Name:    "http_response_size_bytes",
            Help:    "HTTP response size in bytes",
            Buckets: []float64{100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000},
        },
        []string{"method", "path"},
    )

    // Business Metrics
    // Counter: total tasks created
    TasksCreatedTotal = promauto.NewCounter(
        prometheus.CounterOpts{
            Name: "tasks_created_total",
            Help: "Total number of tasks created",
        },
    )

    // Counter: total tasks completed
    TasksCompletedTotal = promauto.NewCounter(
        prometheus.CounterOpts{
            Name: "tasks_completed_total",
            Help: "Total number of tasks completed",
        },
    )

    // Counter: total user registrations
    UserRegistrationsTotal = promauto.NewCounter(
        prometheus.CounterOpts{
            Name: "user_registrations_total",
            Help: "Total number of user registrations",
        },
    )

    // Counter: total login attempts (success/fail)
    LoginAttemptsTotal = promauto.NewCounterVec(
        prometheus.CounterOpts{
            Name: "login_attempts_total",
            Help: "Total number of login attempts",
        },
        []string{"status"}, // "success" or "failed"
    )

    // Gauge: active users (currently authenticated sessions)
    ActiveUsersGauge = promauto.NewGauge(
        prometheus.GaugeOpts{
            Name: "active_users",
            Help: "Number of currently active users",
        },
    )

    // Gauge: database connection pool stats
    DBConnectionsActive = promauto.NewGauge(
        prometheus.GaugeOpts{
            Name: "db_connections_active",
            Help: "Number of active database connections",
        },
    )

    DBConnectionsIdle = promauto.NewGauge(
        prometheus.GaugeOpts{
            Name: "db_connections_idle",
            Help: "Number of idle database connections",
        },
    )

    // Histogram: database query duration
    DBQueryDuration = promauto.NewHistogramVec(
        prometheus.HistogramOpts{
            Name:    "db_query_duration_seconds",
            Help:    "Database query duration in seconds",
            Buckets: []float64{0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 5},
        },
        []string{"operation", "table"},
    )
)
```

### Prometheus Middleware — Auto Collect per Request

Ini bagian paling penting. Bikin middleware yang **otomatis** record HTTP metrics untuk setiap request:

```go
// internal/middleware/prometheus.go
package middleware

import (
    "fmt"
    "strconv"
    "time"

    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/metrics"
)

// PrometheusMiddleware records HTTP metrics for every request
func PrometheusMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
    return func(c *gin.Context) {
        // Skip /metrics dan /health endpoint dari recording
        // (biar ga polusi metrics)
        path := c.FullPath()
        if path == "/metrics" || path == "/health" || path == "/ready" {
            c.Next()
            return
        }

        // Kalau FullPath kosong (404), pakai "not_found"
        if path == "" {
            path = "not_found"
        }

        start := time.Now()

        // Process request
        c.Next()

        // After request
        duration := time.Since(start).Seconds()
        status := strconv.Itoa(c.Writer.Status())
        method := c.Request.Method
        responseSize := float64(c.Writer.Size())

        // Record metrics
        metrics.HttpRequestsTotal.WithLabelValues(method, path, status).Inc()
        metrics.HttpRequestDuration.WithLabelValues(method, path).Observe(duration)

        if responseSize > 0 {
            metrics.HttpResponseSize.WithLabelValues(method, path).Observe(responseSize)
        }
    }
}

// NormalizePath normalizes path parameters to reduce label cardinality
// /api/v1/tasks/123 → /api/v1/tasks/:id
// Gin's FullPath() already handles this, tapi ini backup kalau perlu
func NormalizePath(path string) string {
    // Gin's c.FullPath() returns the route pattern, not the actual path
    // So /api/v1/tasks/123 becomes /api/v1/tasks/:id automatically
    // This function is here as documentation
    return path
}
```

**Penting banget:** Kita pakai `c.FullPath()` bukan `c.Request.URL.Path`. Kenapa?

```
c.Request.URL.Path:
- /api/v1/tasks/1
- /api/v1/tasks/2
- /api/v1/tasks/3
- /api/v1/tasks/42
- ... (infinite cardinality!)

c.FullPath():
- /api/v1/tasks/:id
- /api/v1/tasks/:id
- /api/v1/tasks/:id
- /api/v1/tasks/:id
- ... (1 label value)

Kenapa ini penting?
Label cardinality tinggi = Prometheus pakai banyak memory.
1 juta unique label values = Prometheus bisa OOM.
SELALU normalize path parameters!
```

### Register Middleware di Router

```go
// internal/router/router.go
package router

import (
    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/handler"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/middleware"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/service"
    "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
    "time"
)

func Setup(r *gin.Engine, h *Handlers, authService *service.AuthService, redisClient *redis.Client) {
    // Prometheus middleware — HARUS PERTAMA (sebelum middleware lain)
    r.Use(middleware.PrometheusMiddleware())

    // Health check endpoints (public)
    r.GET("/health", handler.HealthCheck)
    r.GET("/ready", handler.ReadinessCheck)  // tambah readiness check
    r.GET("/metrics", handler.MetricsHandler())

    // Rate limiter: 100 requests per minute per IP
    r.Use(middleware.RateLimiter(redisClient, 100, time.Minute))

    // ... rest of routes (sama kayak sebelumnya)
}
```

### Instrument Business Logic

Selain auto-collect di middleware, kamu juga perlu **manually instrument** business events:

```go
// internal/handler/task.go — tambah metrics increment
package handler

import (
    "net/http"
    "strconv"

    "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/metrics"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/model"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/internal/service"
    "github.com/irzan-aldi/task-manager/pkg/response"
)

func (h *TaskHandler) Create(c *gin.Context) {
    userID := c.GetUint("userID")
    boardID, err := strconv.ParseUint(c.Param("boardId"), 10, 64)
    if err != nil {
        response.Error(c, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid board ID")
        return
    }

    var req model.CreateTaskRequest
    if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
        response.Error(c, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
        return
    }

    task, err := h.taskService.Create(uint(boardID), userID, req)
    if err != nil {
        response.Error(c, http.StatusForbidden, err.Error())
        return
    }

    // Increment task created counter
    metrics.TasksCreatedTotal.Inc()

    response.Success(c, http.StatusCreated, "Task created", task)
}
```

```go
// internal/handler/auth.go — tambah login metrics
func (h *AuthHandler) Login(c *gin.Context) {
    var req model.LoginRequest
    if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {
        response.Error(c, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
        return
    }

    token, err := h.authService.Login(req.Email, req.Password)
    if err != nil {
        // Record failed login
        metrics.LoginAttemptsTotal.WithLabelValues("failed").Inc()
        response.Error(c, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Invalid credentials")
        return
    }

    // Record successful login
    metrics.LoginAttemptsTotal.WithLabelValues("success").Inc()
    metrics.ActiveUsersGauge.Inc()

    response.Success(c, http.StatusOK, "Login successful", token)
}
```

### Database Connection Pool Metrics

Bonus: expose database connection pool stats sebagai Prometheus metrics. Ini penting banget buat detect connection leaks.

```go
// internal/metrics/db_collector.go
package metrics

import (
    "database/sql"
    "time"
)

// StartDBMetricsCollector periodically collects DB pool stats
func StartDBMetricsCollector(sqlDB *sql.DB, interval time.Duration) {
    go func() {
        for {
            stats := sqlDB.Stats()
            DBConnectionsActive.Set(float64(stats.InUse))
            DBConnectionsIdle.Set(float64(stats.Idle))
            time.Sleep(interval)
        }
    }()
}
```

```go
// cmd/api/main.go — start DB metrics collector
func main() {
    // ... existing setup ...

    // Start DB metrics collector
    sqlDB, _ := db.DB()
    metrics.StartDBMetricsCollector(sqlDB, 15*time.Second)

    // ... rest of main
}
```

Jalanin app dan buka `/metrics`:

curl http://localhost:8080/metrics | grep http_requests_total

## 15.7 Setup Prometheus

### Prometheus Config — prometheus.yml

Prometheus butuh config file yang kasih tau dia **target apa aja** yang harus di-scrape, dan **seberapa sering**.

```yaml
# monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml

# Global config
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s       # Scrape setiap 15 detik (default)
  evaluation_interval: 15s   # Evaluate alert rules setiap 15 detik
  scrape_timeout: 10s        # Timeout per scrape

# Alertmanager config (nanti kita setup)
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
          # - alertmanager:9093

# Alert rules files
rule_files:
  - "alerts/*.yml"

# Scrape configurations — target apa aja yang di-scrape
scrape_configs:
  # Prometheus monitor dirinya sendiri
  - job_name: "prometheus"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:9090"]

  # Go Task Manager API
  - job_name: "task-manager-api"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["api:8080"]    # "api" = Docker service name
    metrics_path: /metrics       # Default, tapi explicit lebih jelas
    scrape_interval: 10s         # Override global, scrape lebih sering

  # Node Exporter (system metrics — CPU, memory, disk, network)
  - job_name: "node-exporter"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["node-exporter:9100"]

  # PostgreSQL Exporter
  - job_name: "postgres-exporter"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["postgres-exporter:9187"]

  # Redis Exporter
  - job_name: "redis-exporter"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["redis-exporter:9121"]

  # Nginx Exporter (kalau pakai nginx-prometheus-exporter)
  - job_name: "nginx-exporter"
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["nginx-exporter:9113"]
```

### Jalanin Prometheus via Docker

```bash
# Quick test — jalanin Prometheus standalone
docker run -d \
  --name prometheus \
  -p 9090:9090 \
  -v $(pwd)/monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml \
  prom/prometheus:v3.4.0

# Buka browser: http://localhost:9090
# Masuk ke Status > Targets — lihat target yang di-scrape
```

### Verify Prometheus

Buka `http://localhost:9090` di browser:

```
1. Cek Targets: Status > Targets
   - Semua target harus "UP" (hijau)
   - Kalau "DOWN" (merah), cek network/firewall

2. Coba Query: masukkan di query box
   - up                    → lihat target mana yang UP/DOWN
   - go_goroutines         → jumlah goroutine di Go app
   - http_requests_total   → total HTTP requests

3. Cek Graph: klik tab "Graph"
   - Pilih range: 15m, 1h, 6h
   - Lihat grafik metrics over time
```
