```hcl
# main.tf — root module

# ==========================================
# NETWORKING
# ==========================================
module "networking" {
  source = "./modules/networking"

  project_name         = var.project_name
  environment          = var.environment
  vpc_cidr             = var.vpc_cidr
  public_subnet_cidrs  = local.public_subnet_cidrs
  private_subnet_cidrs = local.private_subnet_cidrs
}

# ==========================================
# SECURITY
# ==========================================
module "security" {
  source = "./modules/security"

  project_name     = var.project_name
  environment      = var.environment
  vpc_id           = module.networking.vpc_id
  vpc_cidr         = var.vpc_cidr
  app_port         = var.app_port
  allowed_ssh_cidr = var.allowed_ssh_cidr
}

# ==========================================
# DATABASE (RDS PostgreSQL)
# ==========================================
module "database" {
  source = "./modules/database"

  project_name       = var.project_name
  environment        = var.environment
  vpc_id             = module.networking.vpc_id
  private_subnet_ids = module.networking.private_subnet_ids
  db_sg_id           = module.security.db_sg_id
  db_instance_class  = var.db_instance_class
  db_name            = var.db_name
  db_username        = var.db_username
  db_password        = var.db_password
}

# ==========================================
# CACHE (ElastiCache Redis)
# ==========================================
module "cache" {
  source = "./modules/cache"

  project_name       = var.project_name
  environment        = var.environment
  private_subnet_ids = module.networking.private_subnet_ids
  cache_sg_id        = module.security.cache_sg_id
  cache_node_type    = var.cache_node_type
}

# ==========================================
# STORAGE (S3 + ECR)
# ==========================================
module "storage" {
  source = "./modules/storage"

  project_name = var.project_name
  environment  = var.environment
}

# ==========================================
# COMPUTE (EC2)
# ==========================================
module "compute" {
  source = "./modules/compute"

  project_name      = var.project_name
  environment       = var.environment
  instance_type     = var.instance_type
  key_pair_name     = var.key_pair_name
  public_subnet_id  = module.networking.public_subnet_ids[0]
  app_sg_id         = module.security.app_sg_id
  app_port          = var.app_port
  db_endpoint       = module.database.db_endpoint
  db_name           = var.db_name
  db_username       = var.db_username
  db_password       = var.db_password
  redis_endpoint    = module.cache.redis_endpoint
  ecr_repository_url = module.storage.ecr_repository_url
  iam_instance_profile = module.storage.iam_instance_profile_name
}
```

### Module: Networking

```hcl
# modules/networking/variables.tf

variable "project_name" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_cidr" {
  type    = string
  default = "10.0.0.0/16"
}

variable "public_subnet_cidrs" {
  type    = list(string)
  default = ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24"]
}

variable "private_subnet_cidrs" {
  type    = list(string)
  default = ["10.0.10.0/24", "10.0.20.0/24"]
}
```

```hcl
# modules/networking/main.tf

data "aws_availability_zones" "available" {
  state = "available"
}

# ==========================================
# VPC
# ==========================================
resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = var.vpc_cidr
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support   = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-vpc"
  }
}

# ==========================================
# INTERNET GATEWAY
# ==========================================
resource "aws_internet_gateway" "main" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-igw"
  }
}

# ==========================================
# PUBLIC SUBNETS
# ==========================================
resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  count = length(var.public_subnet_cidrs)

  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = var.public_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  availability_zone       = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-public-${count.index + 1}"
    Type = "public"
  }
}

# ==========================================
# PRIVATE SUBNETS
# ==========================================
resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  count = length(var.private_subnet_cidrs)

  vpc_id            = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block        = var.private_subnet_cidrs[count.index]
  availability_zone = data.aws_availability_zones.available.names[count.index]

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-private-${count.index + 1}"
    Type = "private"
  }
}

# ==========================================
# NAT GATEWAY
# ==========================================
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  domain = "vpc"

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-nat-eip"
  }
}

resource "aws_nat_gateway" "main" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat.id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.public[0].id

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-nat"
  }

  depends_on = [aws_internet_gateway.main]
}

# ==========================================
# ROUTE TABLES
# ==========================================

# Public route table
resource "aws_route_table" "public" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id = aws_internet_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-public-rt"
  }
}

# Private route table
resource "aws_route_table" "private" {
  vpc_id = aws_vpc.main.id

  route {
    cidr_block     = "0.0.0.0/0"
    nat_gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.main.id
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-private-rt"
  }
}

# Associations
resource "aws_route_table_association" "public" {
  count = length(var.public_subnet_cidrs)

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.public[count.index].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.public.id
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "private" {
  count = length(var.private_subnet_cidrs)

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.private[count.index].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.private.id
}
```

```hcl
# modules/networking/outputs.tf

output "vpc_id" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.id
}

output "vpc_cidr" {
  value = aws_vpc.main.cidr_block
}

output "public_subnet_ids" {
  value = aws_subnet.public[*].id
}

output "private_subnet_ids" {
  value = aws_subnet.private[*].id
}

output "nat_gateway_ip" {
  value = aws_eip.nat.public_ip
}
```

### Module: Security

```hcl
# modules/security/variables.tf

variable "project_name" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_cidr" {
  type = string
}

variable "app_port" {
  type    = number
  default = 8080
}

variable "allowed_ssh_cidr" {
  type    = string
  default = "0.0.0.0/0"
}
```

```hcl
# modules/security/main.tf

# ==========================================
# APP SECURITY GROUP
# ==========================================
resource "aws_security_group" "app" {
  name        = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-app-sg"
  description = "Security group for Task Manager app server"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  # SSH
  ingress {
    description = "SSH access"
    from_port   = 22
    to_port     = 22
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.allowed_ssh_cidr]
  }

  # App port
  ingress {
    description = "App port"
    from_port   = var.app_port
    to_port     = var.app_port
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  # HTTP
  ingress {
    description = "HTTP"
    from_port   = 80
    to_port     = 80
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  # HTTPS
  ingress {
    description = "HTTPS"
    from_port   = 443
    to_port     = 443
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  # All outbound
  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-app-sg"
  }
}

# ==========================================
# DATABASE SECURITY GROUP
# ==========================================
resource "aws_security_group" "db" {
  name        = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-db-sg"
  description = "Security group for RDS PostgreSQL"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  # PostgreSQL — HANYA dari VPC
  ingress {
    description = "PostgreSQL from VPC"
    from_port   = 5432
    to_port     = 5432
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-db-sg"
  }
}

# ==========================================
# CACHE SECURITY GROUP
# ==========================================
resource "aws_security_group" "cache" {
  name        = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-cache-sg"
  description = "Security group for ElastiCache Redis"
  vpc_id      = var.vpc_id

  # Redis — HANYA dari VPC
  ingress {
    description = "Redis from VPC"
    from_port   = 6379
    to_port     = 6379
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = [var.vpc_cidr]
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-cache-sg"
  }
}
```

```hcl
# modules/security/outputs.tf

output "app_sg_id" {
  value = aws_security_group.app.id
}

output "db_sg_id" {
  value = aws_security_group.db.id
}

output "cache_sg_id" {
  value = aws_security_group.cache.id
}
```

### Module: Database (RDS PostgreSQL)

```hcl
# modules/database/variables.tf

variable "project_name" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "private_subnet_ids" {
  type = list(string)
}

variable "db_sg_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "db_instance_class" {
  type    = string
  default = "db.t3.micro"
}

variable "db_name" {
  type    = string
  default = "task_manager"
}

variable "db_username" {
  type    = string
  default = "postgres"
}

variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "db_engine_version" {
  type    = string
  default = "16.6"
}

variable "db_storage_gb" {
  type    = number
  default = 20
}

variable "multi_az" {
  type    = bool
  default = false
}
```

```hcl
# modules/database/main.tf

# DB Subnet Group — RDS butuh minimal 2 subnet di 2 AZ berbeda
resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "main" {
  name       = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-db-subnet"
  subnet_ids = var.private_subnet_ids

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-db-subnet"
  }
}

# RDS PostgreSQL Instance
resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  identifier = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-db"

  # Engine
  engine         = "postgres"
  engine_version = var.db_engine_version
  instance_class = var.db_instance_class

  # Storage
  allocated_storage     = var.db_storage_gb
  max_allocated_storage = var.db_storage_gb * 2  # auto-scaling storage
  storage_type          = "gp3"
  storage_encrypted     = true

  # Database
  db_name  = var.db_name
  username = var.db_username
  password = var.db_password

  # Network
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.main.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [var.db_sg_id]
  publicly_accessible    = false  # JANGAN bisa diakses dari internet!

  # Availability
  multi_az = var.multi_az

  # Backup
  backup_retention_period = var.environment == "production" ? 7 : 1
  backup_window           = "03:00-04:00"     # UTC, jam 10-11 WIB pagi
  maintenance_window      = "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"

  # Monitoring
  performance_insights_enabled = var.environment == "production"

  # Deletion protection
  deletion_protection = var.environment == "production"
  skip_final_snapshot = var.environment != "production"

  final_snapshot_identifier = var.environment == "production" ? "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-final-snapshot" : null

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-db"
  }
}
```

```hcl
# modules/database/outputs.tf

output "db_endpoint" {
  value       = aws_db_instance.postgres.endpoint
  description = "RDS endpoint (host:port)"
}

output "db_address" {
  value       = aws_db_instance.postgres.address
  description = "RDS hostname"
}

output "db_port" {
  value       = aws_db_instance.postgres.port
  description = "RDS port"
}

output "db_name" {
  value       = aws_db_instance.postgres.db_name
  description = "Database name"
}
```

```hcl
  }
}

# ElastiCache Redis Cluster
resource "aws_elasticache_cluster" "redis" {
  cluster_id           = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-redis"
  engine               = "redis"
  engine_version       = var.redis_engine_version
  node_type            = var.cache_node_type
  num_cache_nodes      = var.num_cache_nodes
  port                 = 6379
  parameter_group_name = "default.redis7"

  subnet_group_name  = aws_elasticache_subnet_group.main.name
  security_group_ids = [var.cache_sg_id]

  # Maintenance
  maintenance_window = "sun:05:00-sun:06:00"

  # Snapshots (for production)
  snapshot_retention_limit = var.environment == "production" ? 3 : 0
  snapshot_window          = "04:00-05:00"

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-redis"
  }
}
```

```hcl
# modules/cache/outputs.tf

output "redis_endpoint" {
  value       = aws_elasticache_cluster.redis.cache_nodes[0].address
  description = "Redis endpoint"
}

output "redis_port" {
  value       = aws_elasticache_cluster.redis.cache_nodes[0].port
  description = "Redis port"
}
```

### Module: Storage (S3 + ECR)

```hcl
# modules/storage/variables.tf

variable "project_name" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment" {
  type = string
}
```

```hcl
# modules/storage/main.tf

# ==========================================
# S3 BUCKET — App assets, uploads, etc.
# ==========================================
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "app" {
  bucket = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-assets"

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-assets"
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "app" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.app.id

  versioning_configuration {
    status = "Enabled"
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "app" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.app.id

  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
      sse_algorithm = "AES256"
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "app" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.app.id

  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

# ==========================================
# ECR — Docker image repository
# ==========================================
resource "aws_ecr_repository" "app" {
  name                 = "${var.project_name}"
  image_tag_mutability = "MUTABLE"

  image_scanning_configuration {
    scan_on_push = true
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-ecr"
  }
}

# ECR Lifecycle Policy — auto-delete old images
resource "aws_ecr_lifecycle_policy" "app" {
  repository = aws_ecr_repository.app.name

  policy = jsonencode({
    rules = [
      {
        rulePriority = 1
        description  = "Keep last 10 images"
        selection = {
          tagStatus   = "any"
          countType   = "imageCountMoreThan"
          countNumber = 10
        }
        action = {
          type = "expire"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

# ==========================================
# IAM ROLE — For EC2 to access ECR, S3
# ==========================================
resource "aws_iam_role" "app" {
  name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-app-role"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  })

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-app-role"
  }
}

# Policy: ECR access
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "ecr_access" {
  name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-ecr-policy"
  role = aws_iam_role.app.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken",
          "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability",
          "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer",
          "ecr:BatchGetImage",
          "ecr:PutImage",
          "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload",
          "ecr:UploadLayerPart",
          "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })
}

# Policy: S3 access
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "s3_access" {
  name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-s3-policy"
  role = aws_iam_role.app.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "s3:GetObject",
          "s3:PutObject",
          "s3:DeleteObject",
          "s3:ListBucket"
        ]
        Resource = [
          aws_s3_bucket.app.arn,
          "${aws_s3_bucket.app.arn}/*"
        ]
      }
    ]
  })
}

# Instance Profile — attach IAM role ke EC2
resource "aws_iam_instance_profile" "app" {
  name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-app-profile"
  role = aws_iam_role.app.name
}
```

```hcl
# modules/storage/outputs.tf

output "s3_bucket_name" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.app.id
}

output "s3_bucket_arn" {
  value = aws_s3_bucket.app.arn
}

output "ecr_repository_url" {
  value = aws_ecr_repository.app.repository_url
}

output "iam_instance_profile_name" {
  value = aws_iam_instance_profile.app.name
}
```

```hcl
# modules/compute/main.tf

# Cari AMI Ubuntu terbaru
data "aws_ami" "ubuntu" {
  most_recent = true
  owners      = ["099720109477"]  # Canonical

  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["ubuntu/images/hvm-ssd/ubuntu-jammy-22.04-amd64-server-*"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "virtualization-type"
    values = ["hvm"]
  }
}

# EC2 Instance
resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  ami                  = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id
  instance_type        = var.instance_type
  key_name             = var.key_pair_name
  subnet_id            = var.public_subnet_id
  iam_instance_profile = var.iam_instance_profile

  vpc_security_group_ids = [var.app_sg_id]

  root_block_device {
    volume_size = 20
    volume_type = "gp3"
    encrypted   = true
  }

  # User data script — auto-setup Docker dan deploy app
  user_data = base64encode(templatefile("${path.module}/user_data.sh", {
    app_port           = var.app_port
    db_host            = split(":", var.db_endpoint)[0]
    db_port            = "5432"
    db_name            = var.db_name
    db_username        = var.db_username
    db_password        = var.db_password
    redis_host         = var.redis_endpoint
    redis_port         = "6379"
    ecr_repository_url = var.ecr_repository_url
    environment        = var.environment
  }))

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-app"
  }
}
```

```bash
# modules/compute/user_data.sh

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Update system
apt-get update -y
apt-get upgrade -y

# Install Docker
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
systemctl enable docker
systemctl start docker

# Install AWS CLI
apt-get install -y awscli

# Login ke ECR
aws ecr get-login-password --region ap-southeast-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${ecr_repository_url}

# Pull dan run app
docker pull ${ecr_repository_url}:latest

docker run -d \
  --name task-manager \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -p ${app_port}:${app_port} \
  -e APP_ENV=${environment} \
  -e PORT=${app_port} \
  -e DB_HOST=${db_host} \
  -e DB_PORT=${db_port} \
  -e DB_NAME=${db_name} \
  -e DB_USER=${db_username} \
  -e DB_PASSWORD='${db_password}' \
  -e REDIS_HOST=${redis_host} \
  -e REDIS_PORT=${redis_port} \
  ${ecr_repository_url}:latest

echo "Task Manager API deployed successfully!"
```

```hcl
}

  value = aws_instance.app.public_ip
}

output "public_dns" {
  value = aws_instance.app.public_dns
}
```

## 17.14 Terraform Workspace — Multi-Environment

### Problem

Gimana kalau kamu mau punya **dev, staging, production** tapi pakai **code yang sama**? Copy-paste folder? Itu ga DRY.

### Workspace Solution

Terraform **workspace** itu fitur built-in untuk manage multiple environments dari satu set configuration files. Setiap workspace punya **state file sendiri**.

```bash
# Lihat workspace yang ada
terraform workspace list
# * default

# Bikin workspace baru
terraform workspace new dev
terraform workspace new staging
terraform workspace new production

# Pindah workspace
terraform workspace select dev

# Lihat workspace active
terraform workspace show
# dev
```

### Workspace di Code

```hcl
# Gunakan terraform.workspace untuk conditional logic

locals {
  environment = terraform.workspace

  instance_types = {
    dev        = "t3.micro"
    staging    = "t3.small"
    production = "t3.medium"
  }

  db_instance_classes = {
    dev        = "db.t3.micro"
    staging    = "db.t3.small"
    production = "db.t3.medium"
  }

  multi_az = {
    dev        = false
    staging    = false
    production = true
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  instance_type = local.instance_types[terraform.workspace]
  # dev → t3.micro, staging → t3.small, production → t3.medium
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  instance_class = local.db_instance_classes[terraform.workspace]
  multi_az       = local.multi_az[terraform.workspace]
}
```

### Workspace vs Separate Directories

```
WORKSPACE approach:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
terraform/
├── main.tf         ← 1 set code
├── variables.tf
└── outputs.tf

terraform workspace select dev → state: dev
terraform workspace select prod → state: prod

Pros: DRY, satu codebase
Cons: Semua environment share sama code
      Susah kalau environment beda signifikan

SEPARATE DIRECTORIES approach:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
terraform/
├── modules/        ← shared modules
├── dev/
│   ├── main.tf     ← reference modules
│   └── terraform.tfvars
├── staging/
│   ├── main.tf     ← reference modules
│   └── terraform.tfvars
└── production/
    ├── main.tf     ← reference modules
    └── terraform.tfvars

Pros: Setiap environment bisa beda
      Lebih explicit, more control
Cons: Sedikit duplication

RECOMMENDATION:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Small projects: Workspace cukup
- Large/complex projects: Separate directories + shared modules
- Enterprise: Separate directories (lebih aman, isolated state)
```

### Backend Key per Workspace

```hcl
# Kalau pakai workspace + remote backend:
backend "s3" {
  bucket         = "task-manager-terraform-state"
  key            = "task-manager/terraform.tfstate"  # Terraform auto-prefix dengan workspace
  region         = "ap-southeast-1"
  dynamodb_table = "task-manager-terraform-locks"
  encrypt        = true
}

# State file locations:
# dev:        task-manager/env:/dev/terraform.tfstate
# staging:    task-manager/env:/staging/terraform.tfstate
# production: task-manager/env:/production/terraform.tfstate
```

## 17.15 Terraform with Kubernetes — Provision EKS

Di Bab 16, kamu belajar Kubernetes. Sekarang kita provision **EKS cluster** pakai Terraform — bukan klik-klik di Console.

### EKS Cluster dengan Terraform

```hcl
# eks.tf — Provision EKS cluster

# IAM Role for EKS Cluster
resource "aws_iam_role" "eks_cluster" {
  name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-eks-cluster-role"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "eks.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "eks_cluster_policy" {
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
  role       = aws_iam_role.eks_cluster.name
}

# EKS Cluster
resource "aws_eks_cluster" "main" {
  name     = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}"
  role_arn = aws_iam_role.eks_cluster.arn
  version  = "1.32"

  vpc_config {
    subnet_ids = concat(
      module.networking.public_subnet_ids,
      module.networking.private_subnet_ids
    )

    endpoint_private_access = true
    endpoint_public_access  = true
  }

  depends_on = [
    aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.eks_cluster_policy,
  ]

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-eks"
  }
}

# IAM Role for EKS Node Group
resource "aws_iam_role" "eks_nodes" {
  name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-eks-node-role"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "ec2.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "eks_worker_node_policy" {
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
  role       = aws_iam_role.eks_nodes.name
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "eks_cni_policy" {
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
  role       = aws_iam_role.eks_nodes.name
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "eks_ecr_policy" {
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
  role       = aws_iam_role.eks_nodes.name
}

# EKS Node Group
resource "aws_eks_node_group" "main" {
  cluster_name    = aws_eks_cluster.main.name
  node_group_name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-nodes"
  node_role_arn   = aws_iam_role.eks_nodes.arn
  subnet_ids      = module.networking.private_subnet_ids

  scaling_config {
    desired_size = var.environment == "production" ? 3 : 2
    max_size     = var.environment == "production" ? 5 : 3
    min_size     = var.environment == "production" ? 2 : 1
  }

  instance_types = [var.environment == "production" ? "t3.medium" : "t3.small"]

  depends_on = [
    aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.eks_worker_node_policy,
    aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.eks_cni_policy,
    aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.eks_ecr_policy,
  ]

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-node-group"
  }
}

# Outputs
output "eks_cluster_endpoint" {
  value = aws_eks_cluster.main.endpoint
}

output "eks_cluster_name" {
  value = aws_eks_cluster.main.name
}

output "eks_cluster_ca_certificate" {
  value     = aws_eks_cluster.main.certificate_authority[0].data
  sensitive = true
}
```

### Pakai Community Module (Lebih Simpel)

```hcl
# Pakai terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws — jauh lebih simpel

module "eks" {
  source  = "terraform-aws-modules/eks/aws"
  version = "~> 20.0"

  cluster_name    = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}"
  cluster_version = "1.32"

  vpc_id     = module.networking.vpc_id
  subnet_ids = module.networking.private_subnet_ids

  # Cluster endpoint access
  cluster_endpoint_public_access = true

  # EKS Managed Node Groups
  eks_managed_node_groups = {
    general = {
      desired_size = 2
      min_size     = 1
      max_size     = 5

      instance_types = ["t3.small"]
      capacity_type  = "ON_DEMAND"

      labels = {
        role = "general"
      }
    }
  }

  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
    Project     = var.project_name
  }
}
```

### Kubernetes + Helm Provider

Setelah EKS cluster di-provision, kamu bisa manage K8s resources langsung dari Terraform:

```hcl
# kubernetes-resources.tf

# Configure Kubernetes provider
provider "kubernetes" {
  host                   = module.eks.cluster_endpoint
  cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.eks.cluster_certificate_authority_data)

  exec {
    api_version = "client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1"
    command     = "aws"
    args        = ["eks", "get-token", "--cluster-name", module.eks.cluster_name]
  }
}

# Configure Helm provider
provider "helm" {
  kubernetes {
    host                   = module.eks.cluster_endpoint
    cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(module.eks.cluster_certificate_authority_data)

    exec {
      api_version = "client.authentication.k8s.io/v1beta1"
      command     = "aws"
      args        = ["eks", "get-token", "--cluster-name", module.eks.cluster_name]
    }
  }
}

# Deploy Nginx Ingress Controller via Helm
resource "helm_release" "nginx_ingress" {
  name       = "nginx-ingress"
  repository = "https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx"
  chart      = "ingress-nginx"
  namespace  = "ingress-nginx"

  create_namespace = true

  set {
    name  = "controller.service.type"
    value = "LoadBalancer"
  }
}

# Deploy app namespace
resource "kubernetes_namespace" "app" {
  metadata {
    name = var.project_name
  }
}

# Deploy ConfigMap
resource "kubernetes_config_map" "app" {
  metadata {
    name      = "${var.project_name}-config"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.app.metadata[0].name
  }

  data = {
    APP_ENV    = var.environment
    PORT       = tostring(var.app_port)
    DB_HOST    = module.database.db_address
    DB_PORT    = "5432"
    DB_NAME    = var.db_name
    REDIS_HOST = module.cache.redis_endpoint
    REDIS_PORT = "6379"
  }
}

# Deploy Secret
resource "kubernetes_secret" "app" {
  metadata {
    name      = "${var.project_name}-secret"
    namespace = kubernetes_namespace.app.metadata[0].name
  }

  data = {
    DB_PASSWORD = var.db_password
    JWT_SECRET  = var.jwt_secret
  }
}
```

## 17.16 CI/CD Integration — Terraform di GitHub Actions

### Workflow: Plan on PR, Apply on Merge

```
PR dibuat:
━━━━━━━━━
1. terraform fmt -check (format check)
2. terraform init
3. terraform validate
4. terraform plan
5. Post plan output as PR comment ← reviewer bisa lihat apa yang berubah!

PR di-merge ke main:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. terraform init
2. terraform plan
3. terraform apply -auto-approve
```

### Full GitHub Actions Workflow

```yaml
# .github/workflows/terraform.yml

name: Terraform

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'terraform/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'terraform/**'

env:
  TF_VERSION: '1.12.0'
  AWS_REGION: 'ap-southeast-1'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write  # untuk post comment di PR

jobs:
  # ==================================
  # JOB 1: Terraform Format & Validate
  # ==================================
  format:
    name: Format & Validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: terraform

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ env.TF_VERSION }}

      - name: Terraform Format Check
        run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init -backend=false

      - name: Terraform Validate
        run: terraform validate

  # ==================================
  # JOB 2: Terraform Plan (on PR)
  # ==================================
  plan:
    name: Plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: format
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: terraform

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ env.TF_VERSION }}

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init

      - name: Terraform Plan
        id: plan
        run: terraform plan -var-file="environments/production.tfvars" -no-color -out=tfplan
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Post Plan to PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          PLAN: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.stdout }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const output = `#### Terraform Plan
            \`\`\`
            ${process.env.PLAN}
            \`\`\`

            *Pushed by: @${{ github.actor }}, Action: \`${{ github.event_name }}\`*`;

            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: output
            });

      - name: Plan Status
        if: steps.plan.outcome == 'failure'
        run: exit 1

  # ==================================
  # JOB 3: Terraform Apply (on merge)
  # ==================================
  apply:
    name: Apply
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: format
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    environment: production  # require manual approval (optional)
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: terraform

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ env.TF_VERSION }}

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init

      - name: Terraform Plan
        run: terraform plan -var-file="environments/production.tfvars" -out=tfplan

      - name: Terraform Apply
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve tfplan
```

### GitHub Secrets yang Perlu Disetting

```
Repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions

Secrets yang dibutuhkan:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID       → IAM user access key
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY   → IAM user secret key
TF_VAR_db_password      → Database password (optional, bisa juga via tfvars)
```

### Atlantis — Alternative Approach

```
Atlantis itu tool yang automate Terraform workflow di PR:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Developer bikin PR yang ubah .tf files
2. Atlantis otomatis run terraform plan
3. Plan output di-post sebagai PR comment
4. Reviewer cek plan
5. Reviewer comment "atlantis apply" di PR
6. Atlantis run terraform apply
7. Done!

Benefits:
- Ga perlu setup GitHub Actions sendiri
- Built-in locking (1 apply at a time)
- PR-based workflow
- Team bisa review plan sebelum apply

Install: self-host di EC2 atau pakai managed (env0, Spacelift)
```

## 17.17 Import Existing Resources

### Scenario

Kamu udah punya resources di AWS yang dibuat manual (klik-klik Console). Sekarang mau manage pakai Terraform. Gimana?

### terraform import

```bash
# Format: terraform import <RESOURCE_ADDRESS> <RESOURCE_ID>

# Import EC2 instance
terraform import aws_instance.app i-0abc123def456789

# Import RDS instance
terraform import aws_db_instance.postgres task-manager-production-db

# Import S3 bucket
terraform import aws_s3_bucket.app task-manager-production-assets

# Import Security Group
terraform import aws_security_group.app sg-0abc123def456789

# Import VPC
terraform import aws_vpc.main vpc-0abc123def456789
```

### Step-by-Step Import Workflow

```
Step 1: Tulis resource block yang KOSONG (placeholder)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

```hcl
# main.tf — tulis resource placeholder
resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  # kosong dulu — akan diisi setelah import
}
```

```
Step 2: Import
━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

```bash
terraform import aws_instance.app i-0abc123def456789
# Import successful!
```

```
Step 3: Lihat state
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

```bash
terraform state show aws_instance.app
# ami                          = "ami-0abcdef1234567890"
# instance_type                = "t3.small"
# key_name                     = "my-key"
# subnet_id                    = "subnet-0abc123"
# vpc_security_group_ids       = ["sg-0abc123"]
# tags                         = {
#     "Name" = "task-manager-app"
# }
```

```
Step 4: Isi resource block berdasarkan state output
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

```hcl
resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  ami                    = "ami-0abcdef1234567890"
  instance_type          = "t3.small"
  key_name               = "my-key"
  subnet_id              = "subnet-0abc123"
  vpc_security_group_ids = ["sg-0abc123"]

  tags = {
    Name = "task-manager-app"
  }
}
```

```
Step 5: Verify — terraform plan harus "No changes"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

```bash
terraform plan
# No changes. Your infrastructure matches the configuration.
```

### Import Block (Terraform 1.5+)

Terraform 1.5 ke atas punya cara import yang lebih clean:

```hcl
# import.tf — declarative import

import {
  to = aws_instance.app
  id = "i-0abc123def456789"
}

import {
  to = aws_s3_bucket.app
  id = "task-manager-production-assets"
}

import {
  to = aws_security_group.app
  id = "sg-0abc123def456789"
}
```

```bash
# Generate config dari imported resources
terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf

# Review generated.tf — Terraform auto-generate resource configuration!
# Lalu pindahkan ke file yang tepat dan cleanup
```

## 17.18 Lifecycle & Meta-Arguments

### depends_on — Explicit Dependencies

Biasanya Terraform otomatis detect dependency. Tapi kadang perlu explicit:

```hcl
resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id
  instance_type = "t3.micro"

  # Explicit: tunggu RDS dan ElastiCache ready dulu
  depends_on = [
    aws_db_instance.postgres,
    aws_elasticache_cluster.redis,
  ]
}
```

### count — Create Multiple Resources

```hcl
# Bikin 3 EC2 instances
resource "aws_instance" "worker" {
  count = 3

  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id
  instance_type = "t3.micro"

  tags = {
    Name = "worker-${count.index + 1}"
    # worker-1, worker-2, worker-3
  }
}

# Reference: aws_instance.worker[0], aws_instance.worker[1], aws_instance.worker[2]

# Conditional creation
resource "aws_instance" "bastion" {
  count = var.environment == "production" ? 1 : 0
  # production → bikin 1. staging/dev → ga bikin (0)

  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id
  instance_type = "t3.micro"

  tags = {
    Name = "bastion-host"
  }
}
```

### for_each — Create Resources from Map/Set

```hcl
# for_each lebih bagus dari count karena kamu punya KEY sebagai identifier

variable "instances" {
  type = map(object({
    instance_type = string
    subnet_id     = string
  }))
  default = {
    web = {
      instance_type = "t3.small"
      subnet_id     = "subnet-abc123"
    }
    api = {
      instance_type = "t3.micro"
      subnet_id     = "subnet-def456"
    }
    worker = {
      instance_type = "t3.medium"
      subnet_id     = "subnet-ghi789"
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  for_each = var.instances

  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id
  instance_type = each.value.instance_type
  subnet_id     = each.value.subnet_id

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project_name}-${each.key}"
    # task-manager-web, task-manager-api, task-manager-worker
  }
}

# Reference: aws_instance.app["web"], aws_instance.app["api"], aws_instance.app["worker"]

# for_each with set of strings
resource "aws_iam_user" "developers" {
  for_each = toset(["alice", "bob", "charlie"])

  name = each.value
}
```

### count vs for_each

```
count:
━━━━━
- Pakai INDEX (0, 1, 2, ...)
- Kalau delete item di tengah → semua index setelahnya bergeser → recreate!
- Bagus untuk: conditional creation (count = 0 or 1)

for_each:
━━━━━━━━
- Pakai KEY (string identifier)
- Delete item → cuma item itu yang dihapus. Yang lain ga terpengaruh.
- Bagus untuk: multiple resources dari map/set

RULE OF THUMB:
- Pakai count untuk conditional (count = var.enabled ? 1 : 0)
- Pakai for_each untuk lists of resources
```

### lifecycle — Control Resource Lifecycle

```hcl
resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  identifier     = "task-manager-db"
  engine         = "postgres"
  instance_class = "db.t3.micro"
  # ...

  lifecycle {
    # 1. create_before_destroy
    # Bikin yang baru DULU, baru hapus yang lama
    # Berguna untuk zero-downtime updates
    create_before_destroy = true

    # 2. prevent_destroy
    # JANGAN BISA di-destroy! Terraform error kalau coba destroy.
    # Berguna untuk database, S3 bucket berisi data penting
    prevent_destroy = true

    # 3. ignore_changes
    # Abaikan perubahan pada attribute tertentu
    # Berguna kalau attribute di-manage di luar Terraform
    ignore_changes = [
      tags,                    # tags diubah manual? ga apa-apa
      engine_version,          # auto-update oleh AWS? abaikan
    ]
  }
}

resource "aws_instance" "app" {
  ami           = data.aws_ami.ubuntu.id
  instance_type = var.instance_type

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
    # Update instance type? Bikin instance baru dulu,
    # pindah traffic, baru hapus yang lama
  }
}
```

### Dynamic Blocks

```hcl
# Dynamic block = looping di dalam resource block

variable "ingress_rules" {
  type = list(object({
    port        = number
    protocol    = string
    cidr_blocks = list(string)
    description = string
  }))
  default = [
    {
      port        = 80
      protocol    = "tcp"
      cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
      description = "HTTP"
    },
    {
      port        = 443
      protocol    = "tcp"
      cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
      description = "HTTPS"
    },
    {
      port        = 8080
      protocol    = "tcp"
      cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
      description = "App port"
    },
    {
      port        = 22
      protocol    = "tcp"
      cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
      description = "SSH from VPC"
    },
  ]
}

resource "aws_security_group" "app" {
  name   = "app-sg"
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id

  # Tanpa dynamic block: harus nulis 4 ingress block manual
  # Dengan dynamic block: loop!

  dynamic "ingress" {
    for_each = var.ingress_rules

    content {
      from_port   = ingress.value.port
      to_port     = ingress.value.port
      protocol    = ingress.value.protocol
      cidr_blocks = ingress.value.cidr_blocks
      description = ingress.value.description
    }
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}
```

## 17.19 Terraform Functions — Built-in Functions

Terraform punya banyak built-in functions. Ini yang paling sering dipakai:

### String Functions

```hcl
# format — string formatting
locals {
  server_name = format("%s-%s-server-%02d", var.project_name, var.environment, 1)
  # "task-manager-production-server-01"
}

# join — join list jadi string
locals {
  subnet_list = join(", ", var.public_subnet_cidrs)
  # "10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24"
}

# split — split string jadi list
locals {
  db_host = split(":", var.db_endpoint)[0]
  # "task-manager-db.abc123.ap-southeast-1.rds.amazonaws.com"
}

# upper, lower, title
locals {
  env_upper = upper(var.environment)   # "PRODUCTION"
  env_lower = lower(var.environment)   # "production"
}

# replace
locals {
  clean_name = replace(var.project_name, "_", "-")
  # "task-manager" (kalau input "task_manager")
}

# trimspace, trimprefix, trimsuffix
locals {
  clean = trimspace("  hello  ")           # "hello"
  no_prefix = trimprefix("vpc-main", "vpc-")  # "main"
}

# substr
locals {
  short_hash = substr(var.commit_hash, 0, 7)  # "abc1234"
}
```

### Collection Functions

```hcl
# length — hitung jumlah element
locals {
  subnet_count = length(var.public_subnet_cidrs)  # 2
}

# element — ambil element by index
locals {
  first_az = element(data.aws_availability_zones.available.names, 0)
  # "ap-southeast-1a"
}

# lookup — cari value di map (with default)
locals {
  instance_type = lookup(var.instance_types, var.environment, "t3.micro")
  # Kalau var.environment ga ada di map → return "t3.micro"
}

# merge — gabung maps
locals {
  all_tags = merge(
    var.common_tags,
    {
      Name        = "my-resource"
      Environment = var.environment
    }
  )
}

# concat — gabung lists
locals {
  all_subnets = concat(var.public_subnet_cidrs, var.private_subnet_cidrs)
  # ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24", "10.0.10.0/24", "10.0.20.0/24"]
}

# flatten — flatten nested lists
locals {
  all_ips = flatten([
    var.office_ips,
    var.vpn_ips,
    var.developer_ips,
  ])
}

# contains — cek apakah list contains value
locals {
  is_prod = contains(["production", "prod"], var.environment)  # true/false
}

# distinct — hapus duplicates
locals {
  unique_ports = distinct([80, 443, 80, 8080, 443])
  # [80, 443, 8080]
}

# keys, values — ambil keys/values dari map
locals {
  env_names = keys(var.instance_types)     # ["dev", "staging", "production"]
  env_types = values(var.instance_types)   # ["t3.micro", "t3.small", "t3.medium"]
}

# zipmap — bikin map dari 2 lists
locals {
  server_ips = zipmap(
    ["web", "api", "worker"],
    ["10.0.1.10", "10.0.1.11", "10.0.1.12"]
  )
  # { web = "10.0.1.10", api = "10.0.1.11", worker = "10.0.1.12" }
}
```

### Numeric Functions

```hcl
# min, max
locals {
  min_size = min(var.desired_count, 1)
  max_size = max(var.desired_count, 10)
}

# ceil, floor
locals {
  workers = ceil(var.total_tasks / 10)  # round up
}

# abs
locals {
  diff = abs(var.a - var.b)
}
```

### Network Functions

```hcl
# cidrsubnet — calculate subnet CIDRs
locals {
  # VPC CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
  # cidrsubnet(prefix, newbits, netnum)
  subnet_1 = cidrsubnet("10.0.0.0/16", 8, 1)   # "10.0.1.0/24"
  subnet_2 = cidrsubnet("10.0.0.0/16", 8, 2)   # "10.0.2.0/24"
  subnet_10 = cidrsubnet("10.0.0.0/16", 8, 10)  # "10.0.10.0/24"
}

# Practical: auto-generate subnet CIDRs
resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  count      = 3
  cidr_block = cidrsubnet(var.vpc_cidr, 8, count.index + 1)
  # 10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.3.0/24
}
```

### File Functions

```hcl
# file — baca file content
locals {
  user_data_script = file("${path.module}/scripts/user_data.sh")
}

# templatefile — baca file dan replace variables
locals {
  user_data = templatefile("${path.module}/scripts/user_data.sh", {
    db_host     = var.db_host
    db_password = var.db_password
    app_port    = var.app_port
  })
}

# fileexists — cek file ada ga
locals {
  has_custom_config = fileexists("${path.module}/custom.conf")
}

# basename, dirname
locals {
  filename = basename("/path/to/file.txt")  # "file.txt"
  dir      = dirname("/path/to/file.txt")   # "/path/to"
}
```

### Type Conversion Functions

```hcl
# tostring, tonumber, tobool
locals {
  port_string = tostring(var.app_port)     # "8080"
  port_number = tonumber("8080")            # 8080
  enabled     = tobool("true")              # true
}

# tolist, toset, tomap
locals {
  unique_cidrs = toset(var.cidr_blocks)
}

# jsonencode, jsondecode
locals {
  policy_json = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "s3:GetObject"
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })
}

# yamlencode
locals {
  config_yaml = yamlencode({
    apiVersion = "v1"
    kind       = "ConfigMap"
    metadata = {
      name = "app-config"
    }
  })
}
```

### Conditional & Loop Expressions

```hcl
# Conditional (ternary)
locals {
  instance_type = var.environment == "production" ? "t3.medium" : "t3.micro"
}

# For expression — transform lists/maps
locals {
  # List comprehension
  upper_names = [for name in var.names : upper(name)]
  # ["ALICE", "BOB", "CHARLIE"]

  # Filter
  production_instances = [
    for k, v in var.instances : v
    if v.environment == "production"
  ]

  # Map comprehension
  instance_map = {
    for name in var.names : name => {
      role = "developer"
      team = "backend"
    }
  }

  # Transform list to map
  subnet_by_az = {
    for s in aws_subnet.public :
    s.availability_zone => s.id
  }
}
```

## 17.20 Security Best Practices

### 1. Jangan Commit State File

```gitignore
# .gitignore
*.tfstate
*.tfstate.*
```

```
KENAPA:
State file berisi SEMUA data resource, termasuk:
- Database password (PLAINTEXT!)
- API keys
- Private IP addresses
- Resource ARNs

Commit ke Git = expose secrets ke siapa aja yang punya akses repo.
SELALU pakai remote backend (S3).
```

### 2. Encrypt State at Rest

```hcl
# S3 backend dengan encryption
backend "s3" {
  bucket         = "my-terraform-state"
  key            = "terraform.tfstate"
  region         = "ap-southeast-1"
  encrypt        = true                    # SSE-S3 encryption
  dynamodb_table = "terraform-locks"       # state locking
}

# S3 bucket pakai KMS encryption
resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "state" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.terraform_state.id

  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
      sse_algorithm     = "aws:kms"
      kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.terraform.arn
    }
  }
}
```

### 3. Pakai IAM Roles, Bukan Access Keys

```hcl
# BURUK — hardcode credentials
provider "aws" {
  region     = "ap-southeast-1"
  access_key = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"        # JANGAN!
  secret_key = "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxR"  # JANGAN!
}

# BAIK — pakai IAM role atau env vars
provider "aws" {
  region = "ap-southeast-1"
  # Credentials dari: IAM role / env vars / shared credentials file
}
```

### 4. Least Privilege IAM Policy

```hcl
# BURUK — terlalu broad
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "too_broad" {
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{
      Effect   = "Allow"
      Action   = "*"            # JANGAN! Ini admin access
      Resource = "*"
    }]
  })
}

# BAIK — specific actions dan resources
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "specific" {
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Action = [
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:PutObject",
      ]
      Resource = [
        "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"  # specific bucket aja
      ]
    }]
  })
}
```

### 5. Sensitive Variables dan Outputs

```hcl
# Mark sensitive variables
variable "db_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true  # ga muncul di plan/apply output
}

# Mark sensitive outputs
output "db_endpoint" {
  value     = aws_db_instance.postgres.endpoint
  sensitive = true  # ga muncul di terminal
}
```

### 6. Security Scanning — tfsec/checkov

```bash
# Install tfsec
brew install tfsec

# Scan Terraform code
tfsec .

# Output:
# Result 1:
#   [AWS018] Resource 'aws_security_group.app' defines a fully open ingress
#   security group rule.
#
#   Impact:     The port is accessible from the internet
#   Resolution: Set a more restrictive cidr range

# Install checkov
pip install checkov

# Scan
checkov -d .

# Output:
# Passed checks: 15, Failed checks: 3, Skipped checks: 0
# Check: CKV_AWS_79: Ensure Instance Metadata Service Version 1 is not enabled
# FAILED for resource: aws_instance.app
```

### 7. Pre-commit Hooks

```yaml
# .pre-commit-config.yaml

repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/antonbabenko/pre-commit-terraform
    rev: v1.96.0
    hooks:
      - id: terraform_fmt          # auto-format
      - id: terraform_validate     # validate
      - id: terraform_tflint       # linting
      - id: terraform_tfsec        # security scan
      - id: terraform_docs         # auto-generate docs
```

```bash
# Install pre-commit
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install

# Sekarang setiap git commit → otomatis check!
```

### Security Checklist

```
Security Best Practices:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
[ ] State file di remote backend (S3) — BUKAN di Git
[ ] State encrypted at rest (S3 encryption + KMS)
[ ] State locking enabled (DynamoDB)
[ ] S3 bucket public access blocked
[ ] Pakai IAM roles, bukan access keys
[ ] Sensitive variables marked sensitive = true
[ ] Sensitive outputs marked sensitive = true
[ ] No hardcoded credentials di .tf files
[ ] .gitignore includes *.tfstate, *.tfvars (yang berisi secrets)
[ ] Least privilege IAM policies
[ ] Security scanning (tfsec/checkov) di CI/CD
[ ] Pre-commit hooks untuk format + validate
[ ] Provider version pinned (~> x.0)
[ ] Terraform version pinned (required_version)
```

## 17.21 Common Issues & Debugging

### 1. State Lock — "Error acquiring the state lock"

```
Error: Error acquiring the state lock
Lock Info:
  ID:        12345-abcde-67890
  Path:      task-manager/terraform.tfstate
  Operation: OperationTypeApply
  Who:       developer-a@laptop
  Created:   2026-05-01 10:00:00
```

```bash
# Penyebab:
# - Terraform apply lagi jalan oleh developer lain
# - Terraform apply sebelumnya crash/timeout, lock ga ke-release

# Solusi 1: Tunggu yang lagi apply selesai

# Solusi 2: Force unlock (HATI-HATI — pastikan ga ada yang lagi apply!)
terraform force-unlock 12345-abcde-67890
```

### 2. Drift Detection — "Resource has been changed outside Terraform"

```bash
# Penyebab: ada orang yang ubah resource langsung di Console, bukan via Terraform

# Detect drift
terraform plan
# ~ aws_instance.app will be updated in-place
#   ~ instance_type: "t3.micro" → "t3.small"
#   → artinya seseorang ubah instance type di Console

# Solusi 1: Sync state ke actual (keep manual change)
terraform apply -refresh-only
# "Update state to match actual"

# Solusi 2: Revert ke Terraform config (override manual change)
terraform apply
# "Change instance_type back to t3.micro (sesuai .tf file)"
```

### 3. Dependency Cycle — "Cycle detected"

```
Error: Cycle: aws_security_group.a, aws_security_group.b
```

```hcl
# Penyebab: A depends on B, tapi B juga depends on A

# BURUK — cycle!
resource "aws_security_group" "a" {
  ingress {
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.b.id]
  }
}
resource "aws_security_group" "b" {
  ingress {
    security_groups = [aws_security_group.a.id]
  }
}

# BAIK — pisah rule ke aws_security_group_rule
resource "aws_security_group" "a" {
  name = "sg-a"
}
resource "aws_security_group" "b" {
  name = "sg-b"
}
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "a_to_b" {
  type                     = "ingress"
  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.a.id
  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.b.id
  from_port                = 8080
  to_port                  = 8080
  protocol                 = "tcp"
}
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "b_to_a" {
  type                     = "ingress"
  security_group_id        = aws_security_group.b.id
  source_security_group_id = aws_security_group.a.id
  from_port                = 5432
  to_port                  = 5432
  protocol                 = "tcp"
}
```

### 4. Provider Version Conflicts

```
Error: Failed to query available provider packages
Could not retrieve the list of available versions for provider hashicorp/aws
```

```bash
# Penyebab: .terraform.lock.hcl outdated atau conflict

# Solusi: delete lock file dan re-init
rm .terraform.lock.hcl
terraform init -upgrade
```

### 5. TF_LOG — Debug Mode

```bash
# Set log level
export TF_LOG=DEBUG    # TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR
export TF_LOG_PATH=terraform.log

terraform plan
# Full debug log di terraform.log

# Unset setelah selesai debug
unset TF_LOG
unset TF_LOG_PATH
```

### 6. Common Errors & Solutions

```
Error: "Error creating X: EntityAlreadyExists"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
→ Resource udah ada di AWS tapi ga ada di state
→ Solusi: terraform import

Error: "Error deleting X: DependencyViolation"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
→ Resource ga bisa dihapus karena masih ada yang depend
→ Solusi: hapus dependent resource dulu, atau pakai depends_on

Error: "Invalid count argument"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
→ count ga bisa reference resource yang belum dibuat
→ Solusi: pakai variable atau data source

Error: "Unsupported attribute"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
→ Attribute ga ada di resource type tersebut
→ Solusi: cek docs provider, mungkin typo atau versi beda

Error: "No matching AMI found"
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
→ Filter di data source ga match AMI manapun
→ Solusi: cek filter name, owners, dan region
```

### Debugging Flowchart

```
Terraform Error?
     │
     ├─ "State lock" ─→ Tunggu / force-unlock
     │
     ├─ "EntityAlreadyExists" ─→ terraform import
     │
     ├─ "DependencyViolation" ─→ Check depends_on
     │
     ├─ "Cycle detected" ─→ Break cycle (pisah rule)
     │
     ├─ "Provider version" ─→ terraform init -upgrade
     │
     ├─ "No changes" tapi harusnya ada ─→ terraform refresh
     │
     ├─ Ga jelas ─→ TF_LOG=DEBUG terraform plan
     │
     └─ Masih ga jelas ─→ terraform state show <resource>
                           → compare state vs actual vs config
```

## 17.22 Terraform vs Others — Cheat Sheet

### Quick Comparison

| | Terraform | CloudFormation | Pulumi | Ansible | CDK |
|---|-----------|---------------|--------|---------|-----|
| **Provisioning** | Ya | Ya | Ya | Limited | Ya |
| **Config Mgmt** | Limited | Tidak | Limited | Ya | Tidak |
| **Multi-cloud** | Ya | Tidak (AWS only) | Ya | Ya | AWS-focused |
| **Language** | HCL | JSON/YAML | Any PL | YAML | TypeScript/Python |
| **State** | File (local/remote) | AWS-managed | File | Stateless | AWS-managed |
| **Plan/Preview** | Ya (plan) | Ya (changeset) | Ya (preview) | Ya (--check) | Ya (diff) |
| **Community** | Huge | AWS only | Growing | Huge | Growing |
| **Learning Curve** | Medium | Medium | Low* | Low | Medium |
| **Drift Detection** | Plan | Drift detection | Refresh | Limited | Drift |
| **Best For** | Multi-cloud IaC | AWS-only shops | Dev-friendly IaC | Server config | AWS dev teams |

*Pulumi low learning curve kalau udah bisa programming language-nya

### When to Use What

```
Terraform: Default choice untuk IaC. Multi-cloud, mature, huge community.
           → Pilihan terbaik untuk kebanyakan use case.

CloudFormation: Kalau perusahaan 100% AWS dan ga mau manage state file.
                → Gratis, no state management overhead.

Pulumi: Kalau tim developer ga mau belajar HCL dan prefer Python/TypeScript.
        → "IaC tapi pakai bahasa programming biasa."

Ansible: Kalau butuh configure EXISTING servers (install packages, copy files).
         → Complementary sama Terraform, bukan replacement.

CDK: Kalau perusahaan AWS-focused dan tim comfortable sama TypeScript/Python.
     → Compiles ke CloudFormation under the hood.
```

## 17.23 CLI Cheat Sheet

### Initialization & Setup

```bash
# Initialize Terraform (download providers, setup backend)
terraform init

# Re-initialize (upgrade providers)
terraform init -upgrade

# Initialize tanpa backend (untuk validate/format aja)
terraform init -backend=false
```

### Planning & Applying

```bash
# Preview changes
terraform plan

# Preview with specific var file
terraform plan -var-file="production.tfvars"

# Preview specific resource
terraform plan -target=aws_instance.app

# Save plan to file
terraform plan -out=tfplan

# Apply changes
terraform apply

# Apply saved plan (skip re-plan)
terraform apply tfplan

# Apply with auto-approve (no prompt)
terraform apply -auto-approve

# Apply specific variable
terraform apply -var="environment=production"

# Apply specific resource only
terraform apply -target=aws_instance.app
```

### Destroying

```bash
# Destroy ALL resources
terraform destroy

# Destroy with auto-approve
terraform destroy -auto-approve

# Destroy specific resource
terraform destroy -target=aws_instance.app

# Plan destroy (preview apa yang bakal dihapus)
terraform plan -destroy
```

### State Management

```bash
# List all resources in state
terraform state list

# Show specific resource
terraform state show aws_instance.app

# Move/rename resource in state
terraform state mv aws_instance.old aws_instance.new

# Remove resource from state (ga delete di cloud)
terraform state rm aws_instance.app

# Pull remote state to local
terraform state pull

# Push local state to remote
terraform state push

# Replace provider in state
terraform state replace-provider hashicorp/aws registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws
```

### Workspace

```bash
# List workspaces
terraform workspace list

# Show current workspace
terraform workspace show

# Create new workspace
terraform workspace new dev

# Switch workspace
terraform workspace select production

# Delete workspace
terraform workspace delete staging
```

### Import

```bash
# Import existing resource
terraform import aws_instance.app i-0abc123def456789

# Import with specific state file
terraform import -state=terraform.tfstate aws_instance.app i-0abc123

# Generate config from import (Terraform 1.5+)
terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf
```

### Format & Validate

```bash
# Format all .tf files
terraform fmt

# Format recursively
terraform fmt -recursive

# Check format (CI/CD — return error kalau not formatted)
terraform fmt -check

# Validate configuration
terraform validate
```

### Output & Info

```bash
# Show all outputs
terraform output

# Show specific output
terraform output public_ip

# Show output without quotes
terraform output -raw public_ip

# Show outputs as JSON
terraform output -json

# Show current state (all resources)
terraform show

# Show specific plan file
terraform show tfplan

# Show Terraform version
terraform version

# Show providers used
terraform providers
```

### Advanced

```bash
# Refresh state (sync with actual cloud resources)
terraform refresh
# Atau lebih aman:
terraform apply -refresh-only

# Taint resource (force recreate on next apply)
terraform taint aws_instance.app
# Deprecated — pakai ini:
terraform apply -replace="aws_instance.app"

# Graph (generate dependency graph in DOT format)
terraform graph | dot -Tpng > graph.png

# Console (interactive expression evaluator)
terraform console
> var.project_name
"task-manager"
> length(var.public_subnet_cidrs)
2
> cidrsubnet("10.0.0.0/16", 8, 1)
"10.0.1.0/24"

# Force unlock state
terraform force-unlock LOCK_ID

# Login to Terraform Cloud
terraform login
```

# Bab 18: Microservices Pattern — Distributed System dari Monolith ke Microservices

## Kenapa Bab Ini Penting?

Ini bab yang paling **konseptual** di seluruh ebook ini. Bab-bab sebelumnya fokus ke tools — Docker, CI/CD, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform. Bab ini fokus ke **arsitektur** — gimana kamu design system yang bisa scale, maintain, dan evolve seiring waktu.

Di Bab 16, kamu udah belajar Kubernetes — orchestrate containers. Di Bab 17, Terraform — infrastructure as code. Sekarang pertanyaannya: **containers apa yang mau di-orchestrate?** Jawaban populernya: microservices.

Tapi — dan ini penting — microservices **bukan silver bullet**. Bukan jawaban untuk semua masalah. Bab ini bakal jujur soal trade-offs, kapan pakai, kapan JANGAN pakai, dan gimana migrate kalau memang waktunya tiba.

```
Sebelum bab ini:
- Task Manager API = 1 monolith Go app
- Semua fitur (auth, user, board, task) dalam 1 codebase
- 1 database PostgreSQL, 1 Redis
- Deploy sebagai 1 container
- Scale = scale semuanya

Setelah bab ini:
- Paham kapan monolith cukup dan kapan perlu microservices
- Bisa design microservices architecture
- Paham communication patterns (REST, gRPC, message queue)
- Bisa implement gRPC service di Go
- Paham API Gateway, Service Discovery, Circuit Breaker
- Paham Saga Pattern, Event-Driven Architecture
- Bisa setup distributed tracing dan logging
- Punya migration strategy dari monolith ke microservices
- Tau anti-patterns yang harus dihindari
```

> **Analogi gampang:** Bayangin warung makan. Satu tukang masak yang bisa masak semua — nasi goreng, mie ayam, bakso, es teh. Itu **monolith**. Sekarang bayangin **food court** — ada stall nasi goreng, stall mie ayam, stall bakso, stall minuman. Setiap stall spesialisasi, punya koki sendiri, bisa scale sendiri (stall bakso rame? tambah koki!). Itu **microservices**. Tapi food court butuh manajemen lebih — siapa yang atur antrian? Gimana kalau stall bakso tutup, stall mie masih buka? Gimana customer bayar kalau setiap stall punya kasir sendiri?

---

## 18.1 Apa Itu Microservices?

### Definisi Simple

**Microservices** itu arsitektur dimana satu aplikasi dipecah jadi **beberapa service kecil** yang masing-masing:
- Punya **satu tanggung jawab** (single responsibility)
- Bisa di-**deploy sendiri** (independently deployable)
- Punya **database sendiri** (decentralized data)
- **Berkomunikasi** via network (HTTP, gRPC, message queue)
- Ditulis oleh **tim terpisah** (bisa bahasa berbeda)

```
Monolith Architecture:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 TASK MANAGER API                  │
│                                                   │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐       │
│  │   Auth    │  │   User   │  │  Board   │       │
│  │  Handler  │  │  Handler │  │  Handler │       │
│  └─────┬────┘  └─────┬────┘  └─────┬────┘       │
│        │              │              │             │
│  ┌─────▼────┐  ┌─────▼────┐  ┌─────▼────┐       │
│  │   Auth   │  │   User   │  │  Board   │       │
│  │  Service │  │  Service │  │  Service │       │
│  └─────┬────┘  └─────┬────┘  └─────┬────┘       │
│        │              │              │             │
│  ┌─────▼──────────────▼──────────────▼─────┐     │
│  │           SHARED DATABASE                │     │
│  │           (PostgreSQL)                   │     │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
│                                                   │
│  1 codebase, 1 deployment, 1 database             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘


Microservices Architecture:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐
│   Auth   │  │   User   │  │  Board   │  │   Task   │  │  Notif   │
│  Service │  │  Service │  │  Service │  │  Service │  │  Service │
│          │  │          │  │          │  │          │  │          │
│  :3001   │  │  :3002   │  │  :3003   │  │  :3004   │  │  :3005   │
│          │  │          │  │          │  │          │  │          │
│ ┌──────┐ │  │ ┌──────┐ │  │ ┌──────┐ │  │ ┌──────┐ │  │ ┌──────┐ │
│ │ DB 1 │ │  │ │ DB 2 │ │  │ │ DB 3 │ │  │ │ DB 4 │ │  │ │Redis │ │
│ └──────┘ │  │ └──────┘ │  │ └──────┘ │  │ └──────┘ │  │ └──────┘ │
└──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘
     ↑              ↑              ↑              ↑              ↑
     └──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
                              │
                    ┌─────────▼─────────┐
                    │   API GATEWAY      │
                    │   :8080            │
                    │   Routing + Auth   │
                    │   + Rate Limiting  │
                    └─────────┬─────────┘
                              │
                         ┌────▼────┐
                         │ Client  │
                         └─────────┘

5 codebases, 5 deployments, 5 databases
```

### Kenapa Microservices Populer?

1. **Independent scaling** — Task Service rame? Scale Task Service aja, ga perlu scale Auth Service
2. **Independent deployment** — Update Notification Service tanpa deploy ulang Board Service
3. **Technology freedom** — Auth Service pakai Go, Notification Service pakai Python? Bisa
4. **Team autonomy** — Tim A handle Auth, Tim B handle Task. Ga saling ganggu
5. **Fault isolation** — Notification Service down? Task Service tetap jalan
6. **Easier to understand** — Setiap service kecil dan fokus. Lebih gampang dipahami 1 developer

### Kenapa BUKAN Selalu Jawaban yang Benar?

> **"If you can't build a well-structured monolith, what makes you think microservices is the answer?"** — Simon Brown

Ini yang sering dilupain: microservices itu **bukan upgrade dari monolith**. Microservices itu **trade-off**. Kamu tukar **complexity di code** dengan **complexity di infrastructure**.

```
Monolith complexity:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Codebase gede
- Coupling antar module
- Deploy semuanya bareng
- Scale semuanya bareng

Microservices complexity:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Network calls bisa fail (latency, timeout, partial failure)
- Distributed transactions (saga, compensation)
- Service discovery (gimana service A nemuin service B?)
- Distributed tracing (request lewat 5 service, error di mana?)
- Data consistency (eventual consistency, bukan ACID)
- Deployment complexity (10 services = 10 CI/CD pipelines)
- Monitoring complexity (10 services = 10 dashboards)
- Testing complexity (integration test across services)
```

### Monolith First

**Martin Fowler** (salah satu founding father software architecture) bilang:

> "Almost all the successful microservice stories have started with a monolith that got too big and was broken up."

Artinya: **mulai dari monolith dulu**. Kalau monolith udah terlalu besar dan painful, baru migrate ke microservices. Jangan mulai dari microservices.

```
Project baru → Monolith ✅
MVP / prototype → Monolith ✅
Tim < 5 orang → Monolith ✅
Belum tau domain boundaries → Monolith ✅
Udah product-market fit, tim growing → Consider microservices 🤔
Traffic pattern jelas, bottleneck teridentifikasi → Microservices ✅
```

---

## 18.2 Monolith vs Microservices — Detailed Comparison

### Comparison Table

| Aspek | Monolith | Microservices |
|-------|----------|---------------|
| **Deployment** | 1 deployment unit | Setiap service deploy sendiri |
| **Scaling** | Scale semuanya | Scale per service |
| **Codebase** | 1 repo (atau mono-repo) | Multi-repo atau mono-repo |
| **Database** | 1 shared database | Database per service |
| **Communication** | Function call (in-process) | Network call (HTTP/gRPC/queue) |
| **Latency** | Microseconds (function call) | Milliseconds (network call) |
| **Data consistency** | ACID transactions | Eventual consistency |
| **Team structure** | 1 tim besar | Banyak tim kecil (2-pizza teams) |
| **Technology** | 1 tech stack | Polyglot (bisa beda bahasa) |
| **Testing** | Unit + integration (simple) | Contract + integration + e2e (complex) |
| **Debugging** | Stack trace langsung | Distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin) |
| **Error handling** | Try/catch | Circuit breaker, retry, timeout |
| **Complexity awal** | Rendah | Tinggi |
| **Complexity seiring grow** | Naik drastis | Terkontrol per service |
| **DevOps maturity needed** | Low-medium | High |
| **Cost** | Lebih murah (awal) | Lebih mahal (infrastructure overhead) |

### Kapan Monolith Lebih Baik?

```
Monolith wins kalau:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Tim kecil (1-5 developer)
   → Microservices butuh DevOps maturity. Tim kecil ga punya bandwidth.

2. Startup awal / MVP
   → Kamu belum tau fitur mana yang bakal survive. Jangan invest di architecture.

3. Domain belum clear
   → Kalau kamu salah pecah service, merge lagi itu PAINFUL.

4. Simple CRUD app
   → Ga semua app butuh microservices. Blog? E-commerce kecil? Monolith cukup.

5. Tight deadline
   → Microservices = lebih banyak setup awal. Monolith = langsung ngoding fitur.

6. Budget terbatas
   → 1 server monolith vs 10+ containers microservices. Beda cost.
```

### Kapan Migrate ke Microservices?

```
Sinyal butuh microservices:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Deployment jadi bottleneck
   → "Kita ga bisa deploy fitur notifikasi karena fitur payment belum ready"
   → Service yang bisa deploy sendiri = unblocked

2. Scaling ga efisien
   → "Auth endpoint kena 10x traffic, tapi kita harus scale SEMUA app"
   → Scale per service = cost efficient

3. Tim mulai saling block
   → "Tim A merge conflict terus sama Tim B"
   → Repo terpisah = ga ada conflict

4. Codebase terlalu besar
   → "Onboarding developer baru butuh 2 minggu buat paham codebase"
   → Service kecil = 1-2 hari paham

5. Different scaling needs
   → "Report generation butuh banyak CPU tapi auth ga"
   → Separate service = optimize per service

6. Technology constraints
   → "ML model kita harus pakai Python tapi backend pakai Go"
   → Polyglot = setiap service bahasa yang cocok
```

---

## 18.3 Microservices Principles

### 1. Single Responsibility

Setiap service punya **satu tanggung jawab yang jelas**. Ini bukan berarti 1 endpoint, tapi 1 **domain/business capability**.

```
✅ Correct service boundaries:
- Auth Service → handle authentication & authorization
- User Service → handle user profiles, CRUD
- Task Service → handle tasks CRUD, assignment
- Notification Service → handle email, push notification

❌ Wrong service boundaries (terlalu kecil):
- Login Service → cuma handle login
- Register Service → cuma handle register
- Password Service → cuma handle password reset
→ Ini NANO-SERVICES. Anti-pattern. Terlalu banyak overhead.

❌ Wrong service boundaries (terlalu besar):
- Backend Service → handle everything
→ Ini cuma monolith yang kamu rename jadi "service"
```

### 2. Independently Deployable

Setiap service bisa di-deploy **tanpa deploy service lain**. Ini berarti:
- Service punya **CI/CD pipeline sendiri**
- Service punya **Docker image sendiri**
- Service punya **version sendiri**
- Perubahan di Service A **ga butuh redeploy** Service B

```
Deployment independence:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Monolith:
  Change auth logic → deploy EVERYTHING → risk breaking task feature

Microservices:
  Change auth logic → deploy ONLY auth service → task service ga kena
```

### 3. Decentralized Data Management

Setiap service **own** datanya sendiri. Ga ada shared database.

```
✅ Database per service:
┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐
│   Auth   │     │   Task   │     │  Notif   │
│  Service │     │  Service │     │  Service │
│          │     │          │     │          │
│  ┌────┐  │     │  ┌────┐  │     │  ┌────┐  │
│  │Auth│  │     │  │Task│  │     │  │Noti│  │
│  │ DB │  │     │  │ DB │  │     │  │f DB│  │
│  └────┘  │     │  └────┘  │     │  └────┘  │
└──────────┘     └──────────┘     └──────────┘

❌ Shared database (anti-pattern):
┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌──────────┐
│   Auth   │     │   Task   │     │  Notif   │
│  Service │     │  Service │     │  Service │
└────┬─────┘     └────┬─────┘     └────┬─────┘
     │                │                │
     └────────────────┼────────────────┘
                      │
                ┌─────▼─────┐
                │ SHARED DB │  ← Coupling! Semua service terikat ke 1 schema
                └───────────┘
```

### 4. Design for Failure

Dalam monolith, function call hampir pasti succeed. Dalam microservices, **network call bisa gagal kapan aja**. Jadi kamu harus **expect failure**.

```
Monolith:
  result = userService.GetByID(123)  // Function call → almost always works

Microservices:
  result = HTTP GET user-service:3002/users/123
  → Network timeout? ← BISA
  → Service down? ← BISA
  → Response corrupt? ← BISA
  → 500 error? ← BISA
  → DNS resolution fail? ← BISA

Solusi:
  → Circuit Breaker (jangan terus panggil service yang down)
  → Retry with backoff (coba lagi, tapi jangan buru-buru)
  → Timeout (jangan nunggu selamanya)
  → Fallback (kalau gagal, kasih default response)
  → Graceful degradation (fitur A down, fitur B masih jalan)
```

### 5. Smart Endpoints, Dumb Pipes

Logika bisnis ada di **service** (smart endpoints), bukan di communication layer (dumb pipes). Message queue atau HTTP cuma transport — ga ada business logic di sana.

```
✅ Smart endpoints, dumb pipes:
  - Service A process business logic
  - Service A publish event ke message queue (dumb pipe)
  - Service B consume event dan process business logic
  → Queue cuma transport. Ga tau isi message-nya apa.

❌ Smart pipes:
  - ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) yang transform, route, dan apply logic
  → Complex, hard to debug, single point of failure
```
